--!strict
-- Kbc.lua -- 8042 keyboard controller with PS/2 keyboard and mouse.
--
-- The 8042 exposes status/data at 0x64/0x60. Host input is injected through
-- pressKey/releaseKey/mouseMove; the controller queues set-1 make/break codes
-- (or 3-byte PS/2 mouse packets) and raises IRQ1/IRQ12. Guest commands are
-- acknowledged with 0xFA so SeaBIOS's keyboard self-test and mouse init finish.

const band, bor = bit32.band, bit32.bor

const Kbc = {}
Kbc.__index = Kbc

const STATUS_OBF = 0x01
const STATUS_SYS = 0x04
const STATUS_AUX = 0x20

export type QueueEntry = {
	value: number,
	aux: boolean,
}

export type Kbc = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		queue: { QueueEntry },
		config: number,
		command: number?,
		pendingData: number?,
		keyboardEnabled: boolean,
		mouseEnabled: boolean,
		irq1: boolean,
		irq12: boolean,
		irq1Armed: boolean,
		irq12Armed: boolean,
		lastStatus: number,
		outputPort: number,
		resetRequested: boolean,
		a20Request: boolean?,
		trace: { string },
		in8: (self: Kbc, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Kbc, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		pressKey: (self: Kbc, scancode: number) -> (),
		releaseKey: (self: Kbc, scancode: number) -> (),
		mouseMove: (self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?) -> (),
		takeIrq1: (self: Kbc) -> boolean,
		takeIrq12: (self: Kbc) -> boolean,
		reset: (self: Kbc) -> (),
	},
	Kbc
))

function Kbc.new(): Kbc
	local self = setmetatable({}, Kbc) :: any
	self.queue = {}
	self.config = 0x45 -- translation, keyboard and mouse IRQs enabled
	self.command = nil
	self.pendingData = nil
	self.keyboardEnabled = true
	self.mouseEnabled = true
	self.irq1 = false
	self.irq12 = false
	self.irq1Armed = false
	self.irq12Armed = false
	self.lastStatus = 0
	self.outputPort = 0x03 -- bit 0: CPU reset line (active low), bit 1: A20 gate
	self.resetRequested = false
	self.a20Request = nil
	self.trace = {}
	return self
end

function Kbc.reset(self: Kbc)
	self.queue = {}
	self.config = 0x45
	self.command = nil
	self.pendingData = nil
	self.keyboardEnabled = true
	self.mouseEnabled = true
	self.irq1 = false
	self.irq12 = false
	self.irq1Armed = false
	self.irq12Armed = false
	self.lastStatus = 0
	self.outputPort = 0x03
	self.resetRequested = false
	self.a20Request = nil
end

local function status(self: Kbc): number
	local value = STATUS_SYS
	if #self.queue > 0 then
		value = bor(value, STATUS_OBF)
	end
	const first = self.queue[1]
	if first and first.aux then
		value = bor(value, STATUS_AUX)
	end
	-- IBF is a momentary host->controller latch. The controller consumes a
	-- command/parameter before the next status read, so SeaBIOS must not see it
	-- stuck (its i8042_wait_write loop would never issue the parameter byte).
	return value
end

local function queueByte(self: Kbc, value: number, aux: boolean)
	self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = { value = band(value, 0xFF), aux = aux }
	if aux then
		if band(self.config, 0x02) ~= 0 then
			self.irq12 = true
			self.irq12Armed = true
		end
	else
		if band(self.config, 0x01) ~= 0 then
			self.irq1 = true
			self.irq1Armed = true
		end
	end
end

local function mousePacket(self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number)
	local x = math.max(-128, math.min(127, math.floor(dx)))
	local y = math.max(-128, math.min(127, math.floor(dy)))
	local flags = bor(0x08, band(buttons, 0x07))
	if x < 0 then
		x += 256
		flags = bor(flags, 0x10)
	end
	if y < 0 then
		y += 256
		flags = bor(flags, 0x20)
	end
	queueByte(self, flags, true)
	queueByte(self, x, true)
	queueByte(self, y, true)
end

function Kbc.pressKey(self: Kbc, scancode: number)
	if not self.keyboardEnabled then
		return
	end
	queueByte(self, band(scancode, 0x7F), false)
end

function Kbc.releaseKey(self: Kbc, scancode: number)
	if not self.keyboardEnabled then
		return
	end
	queueByte(self, bor(0x80, band(scancode, 0x7F)), false)
end

function Kbc.mouseMove(self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?)
	if not self.mouseEnabled then
		return
	end
	mousePacket(self, dx, dy, buttons or 0)
end

function Kbc.takeIrq1(self: Kbc): boolean
	if band(self.config, 0x01) == 0 or not self.irq1Armed then
		return false
	end
	for _, entry in self.queue do
		if not entry.aux then
			self.irq1Armed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	self.irq1Armed = false
	return false
end

function Kbc.takeIrq12(self: Kbc): boolean
	if band(self.config, 0x02) == 0 or not self.irq12Armed then
		return false
	end
	for _, entry in self.queue do
		if entry.aux then
			self.irq12Armed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	self.irq12Armed = false
	return false
end

function Kbc.in8(self: Kbc, port: number): number
	if port == 0x64 then
		const value = status(self)
		self.lastStatus = value
		return value
	end
	if port == 0x60 then
		const entry = table.remove(self.queue, 1)
		if entry then
			if not entry.aux then
				-- One keyboard byte per IRQ1. If more make/break bytes are
				-- queued, arm the next edge now so it is delivered after EOI.
				for _, queued in self.queue do
					if not queued.aux then
						self.irq1Armed = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
			return entry.value
		end
		return 0xFF
	end
	return 0xFF
end

local function guestKeyboardByte(self: Kbc, value: number)
	if self.pendingData == 0xED then
		self.pendingData = nil
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		return
	end
	if self.pendingData == 0xF0 then
		self.pendingData = nil
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		return
	end
	if value == 0xED or value == 0xF0 then
		self.pendingData = value
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
	elseif value == 0xFF then
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		queueByte(self, 0xAA, false)
		self.keyboardEnabled = true
	else
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
	end
end

local function guestMouseByte(self: Kbc, value: number)
	if value == 0xF4 or value == 0xFF then
		self.mouseEnabled = true
	elseif value == 0xF5 then
		self.mouseEnabled = false
	end
	queueByte(self, 0xFA, true)
end

function Kbc.out8(self: Kbc, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if #self.trace < 200 then
		self.trace[#self.trace + 1] = ("W%02X=%02X"):format(port, value)
	end
	if port == 0x60 then
		const command = self.pendingData
		if command == 0x60 then
			self.config = value
			self.pendingData = nil
		elseif command == 0xD4 then
			self.pendingData = nil
			guestMouseByte(self, value)
		elseif command == 0xD1 then
			-- Write output port: bit 1 gates A20, and clearing bit 0 pulls the
			-- CPU reset line. The machine applies both after this write.
			self.pendingData = nil
			self.outputPort = value
			self.a20Request = band(value, 0x02) ~= 0
			if band(value, 0x01) == 0 then
				self.resetRequested = true
			end
		elseif self.command == 0xD2 then
			self.command = nil
			queueByte(self, value, false)
		elseif self.command == 0xD3 then
			self.command = nil
			queueByte(self, value, true)
		else
			guestKeyboardByte(self, value)
		end
		return
	end
	if port ~= 0x64 then
		return
	end
	self.command = value
	if value == 0x20 then
		queueByte(self, self.config, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0x60 then
		self.pendingData = 0x60
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAA then
		queueByte(self, 0x55, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAB then
		queueByte(self, 0x00, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA9 then
		queueByte(self, 0x00, true)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAD then
		self.keyboardEnabled = false
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAE then
		self.keyboardEnabled = true
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA7 then
		self.mouseEnabled = false
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA8 then
		self.mouseEnabled = true
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xD2 or value == 0xD3 then
		self.command = value
	elseif value == 0xD4 then
		self.pendingData = 0xD4
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xD0 then
		queueByte(self, self.outputPort, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xD1 then
		self.pendingData = 0xD1
		self.command = nil
	elseif value >= 0xF0 then
		-- Pulse output port bits whose mask bit is clear. Bit 0 is the CPU
		-- reset line, so 0xFE (and every even 0xFx) resets the processor:
		-- the standard way DOS, Windows and SeaBIOS reboot a PC.
		if band(value, 0x01) == 0 then
			self.resetRequested = true
		end
		self.command = nil
	else
		self.command = nil
	end
end

return Kbc

--!strict
-- The clip's own settings, its markers, and going back to the clip it was opened from.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Convert = require("./Convert")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Operations = require("../Operations")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")
local Store = require("./Store")

local count = Frames.count
local currentBackend = Store.currentBackend
local markerCurve = Store.markerCurve
local near = Frames.near
local needOneOf = Need.needOneOf
local needText = Need.needText
local needTime = Need.needTime
local refuse = Need.refuse

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context
type Marker = Store.Marker

local Ops = {}

Ops.set_properties = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		if operation.name == nil and operation.loop == nil and operation.priority == nil then
			refuse(where, "give name, loop or priority.")
		end
		if operation.name ~= nil then
			needText(where, operation.name, "name", Store.MAX_NAME)
		end
		if operation.loop ~= nil and type(operation.loop) ~= "boolean" then
			refuse(where, "loop must be true or false.")
		end
		if operation.priority ~= nil then
			needOneOf(where, operation.priority, "priority", Store.PRIORITIES)
		end
	end,

	apply = function(_where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local target = clip :: any
		if operation.name ~= nil then
			target.Name = operation.name
		end
		if operation.loop ~= nil then
			target.Loop = operation.loop
		end
		if operation.priority ~= nil then
			target.Priority = (Roblox.Enum.AnimationPriority :: any)[operation.priority]
		end
		count(changed, "properties_changed")
	end,
}

Ops.set_marker = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		needTime(where, operation.time, "time")
		needText(where, operation.name, "name", Store.MAX_NAME)
		if operation.value ~= nil then
			needText(where, operation.value, "value", Store.MAX_MARKER_VALUE, true)
		end
	end,

	apply = function(_where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local curve = markerCurve(clip, operation.name, true) :: Instance
		local markers = currentBackend().markers(curve)
		local found = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if near(marker.time, operation.time) then
				marker.value = operation.value or ""
				found = true
			end
		end
		if not found then
			table.insert(markers, { time = operation.time, value = operation.value or "" })
		end
		table.sort(markers, function(a, b)
			return a.time < b.time
		end)
		currentBackend().setMarkers(curve, markers)
		count(changed, "markers_set")
	end,
}

Ops.remove_marker = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		needTime(where, operation.time, "time")
		needText(where, operation.name, "name", Store.MAX_NAME)
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local curve = markerCurve(clip, operation.name, false)
		local markers: { Marker } = if curve then currentBackend().markers(curve) else {}
		local kept = {}
		for _, marker in markers do
			if not near(marker.time, operation.time) then
				table.insert(kept, marker)
			end
		end
		if #kept == #markers then
			refuse(where, `there is no marker "{operation.name}" at {operation.time} seconds.`)
		end
		if #kept == 0 then
			(curve :: Instance).Parent = nil
		else
			currentBackend().setMarkers(curve :: Instance, kept)
		end
		count(changed, "markers_removed", #markers - #kept)
	end,
}

Ops.restore_source = {
	check = function() end,

	apply = function(_where: string, clip: Instance, _operation: any, context: Context, changed: Changed)
		for _, child in clip:GetChildren() do
			child.Parent = nil
		end
		local source = context.source :: any
		if source then
			-- A working copy converted from a keyframe clip is converted again.
			local from = if source:IsA("KeyframeSequence")
				then Convert.fromKeyframes(source, Operations.keyframes(source), Operations.findPose)
				else source
			for _, child in from:GetChildren() do
				child:Clone().Parent = clip
			end
			(clip :: any).Loop = source.Loop;
			(clip :: any).Priority = source.Priority
		end
		count(changed, "restored")
	end,
}

return Ops

--!strict
-- Lpt.lua -- parallel port LPT1 at 0x378-0x37A with an injected print backend.
--
-- Data written to 0x378 is latched and emitted when the guest pulses STROBE
-- (control bit 0 high-to-low), matching how BIOS INT 17h and Windows' printer
-- drivers drive a Centronics port. INT 17h uses writeByte() directly.

const band, bor = bit32.band, bit32.bor

const Lpt = {}
Lpt.__index = Lpt

Lpt.BASE = 0x378

export type Backend = {
	write: ((backend: any, text: string) -> ())?,
}

export type Lpt = {
	backend: Backend?,
	data: number,
	control: number,
	bytes: number,
	new: (backend: Backend?) -> Lpt,
	reset: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	status: (self: Lpt) -> number,
	intStatus: (self: Lpt) -> number,
	emit: (self: Lpt, text: string) -> (),
	writeByte: (self: Lpt, value: number) -> (),
	writeText: (self: Lpt, text: string) -> (),
	initialize: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	strobe: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	in8: (self: Lpt, port: number) -> number,
	out8: (self: Lpt, port: number, value: number) -> (),
}

function Lpt.new(backend: Backend?): Lpt
	const self = setmetatable({}, Lpt) :: any
	self.backend = backend
	self:reset()
	return self
end

function Lpt.reset(self: Lpt)
	self.data = 0
	self.control = 0x0C -- SELECT and INIT asserted, STROBE low
	self.bytes = 0
end

-- Parallel-port status byte: ~BUSY, ~ACK, PE, SELECT, ~ERROR.
function Lpt.status(_self: Lpt): number
	return 0xDF -- ready, selected, no paper error
end

-- INT 17h AH status: not busy, selected, no error/timeout.
function Lpt.intStatus(_self: Lpt): number
	return 0x90
end

function Lpt.emit(self: Lpt, text: string)
	const backend = self.backend
	if backend and backend.write then
		backend.write(backend, text)
	end
	self.bytes += #text
end

-- INT 17h AH=00 prints a byte without a guest-visible strobe.
function Lpt.writeByte(self: Lpt, value: number)
	self.data = band(value, 0xFF)
	self:emit(string.char(self.data))
end

function Lpt.writeText(self: Lpt, text: string)
	for index = 1, #text do
		self.data = string.byte(text, index) :: number
	end
	if #text > 0 then
		self:emit(text)
	end
end

function Lpt.initialize(self: Lpt)
	-- INIT is active low; pulse it and leave the port selected.
	self.control = 0x08
	self.control = bor(self.control, 0x04)
end

function Lpt.strobe(self: Lpt)
	self:emit(string.char(self.data))
end

function Lpt.in8(self: Lpt, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - Lpt.BASE, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		return self.data
	elseif offset == 1 then
		return self:status()
	elseif offset == 2 then
		return self.control
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Lpt.out8(self: Lpt, port: number, value: number)
	const byte = band(value, 0xFF)
	const offset = band(port - Lpt.BASE, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		self.data = byte
	elseif offset == 2 then
		const previous = self.control
		self.control = byte
		-- Centronics latches on the falling edge of STROBE.
		if band(previous, 0x01) ~= 0 and band(byte, 0x01) == 0 then
			self:strobe()
		end
	end
end

return Lpt

-- ContentProvider on a server, and how content properties store strings.
local CP = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
log("RequestQueueSize", CP.RequestQueueSize)

-- Nothing to fetch: returns at once, without yielding.
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
CP:PreloadAsync({})
CP:PreloadAsync({ "", folder }, function(id) log("callback", id) end)
log("nothing to fetch returned")
folder:Destroy()

-- Something to fetch: a server never finishes.
local finished = false
task.spawn(function()
    CP:PreloadAsync({ "abc" }, function(id, status) log("callback", id, status) end)
    finished = true
end)
task.wait(1)
log("server preload finished", finished)

for _, case in {
    { "string", "abc" },
    { "number", 5 },
    { "bool element", { true } },
    { "number element", { 5 } },
    { "Vector3 element", { Vector3.zero } },
} do
    log(case[1], pcall(CP.PreloadAsync, CP, case[2]))
end
log("nil", pcall(CP.PreloadAsync, CP))
log("number callback", pcall(CP.PreloadAsync, CP, {}, 5))

-- Content properties: backslashes in rbxasset:// paths become slashes,
-- case is kept, other strings are kept as they are.
local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
for _, value in {
    "rbxasset://Fonts\\Head.mesh",
    "rbxassetid://12221462",
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=12221462",
    "  rbxassetid://5 ",
    "abc",
    "",
} do
    mesh.MeshId = value
    sound.SoundId = value
    log(string.format("%q -> %q %q", value, mesh.MeshId, sound.SoundId))
end
mesh:Destroy()
sound:Destroy()

--!strict
-- Checks of a curve clip: the general ones, and contact with the floor at every frame.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Body = require("./Body")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Pose = require("../../Rigs/Pose")
local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")
local Store = require("./Store")

local floorOf = Body.floorOf
local hasGeometry = Body.hasGeometry
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local milliseconds = Need.milliseconds
local NOT_FLOORED = Body.NOT_FLOORED
local readChannels = Frames.readChannels
local rounded = Need.rounded
local transformsAt = Frames.transformsAt

local Contacts = {}

-- The rotation of a joint at a time, from its three rotation channels.
local function rotationAt(clip: Instance, joint: string, time: number): CFrame
	local angles = {}
	for index, letter in { "x", "y", "z" } do
		local curve = Store.channel(clip, joint, `rotation.{letter}`, false)
		angles[index] = if curve then Store.evaluate(Store.keys(curve), time) else 0
	end
	return Roblox.CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(angles[1], angles[2], angles[3])
end

local function turn(a: CFrame, b: CFrame): number
	local squares = (a.RightVector - b.RightVector).Magnitude ^ 2
		+ (a.UpVector - b.UpVector).Magnitude ^ 2
		+ (a.LookVector - b.LookVector).Magnitude ^ 2
	return math.deg(2 * math.asin(math.min(1, math.sqrt(squares / 8))))
end

-- Contact with the ground, measured as Studio shows the clip: at every whole frame. The
-- floor is where the rig's lowest point is in its rest pose (see floorOf). A part that
-- goes below it is in the ground. A foot that rests on it for a few frames is planted,
-- and should not slide while it is.

-- A foot touches the floor when its lowest point is within this share of the floor
-- limit of it; and moving faster than this across the floor while it touches, in studs a
-- second both coming into a frame and going out of it, it scuffs. A swing that skims the
-- floor moves at 5 to 10; a planted foot that creeps with the hips, under this, slides.
local TOUCH = 0.4
local SCUFF_SPEED = 3
-- In a looping clip, a floor whose soles step back slower than this, in studs a second,
-- is taken to stand still.
local MOVING_FLOOR = 0.5

local function contacts(
	clip: Instance,
	joints: { [string]: any },
	thresholds: { [string]: number },
	report: (issue: any) -> ()
)
	if not hasGeometry(joints, Rig.R15_ORDER) then
		return
	end
	local duration = Store.duration(clip)
	local rate = Store.FRAME_RATE
	local scan = { joints = joints } :: any
	local identity = Roblox.CFrame.new()
	local floor = floorOf(joints)
	local channels = readChannels(clip)
	local frames = math.floor(duration * rate + 1e-6)
	type Below = { deepest: number, at: number, first: number, last: number }
	local below: { [string]: Below } = {}
	local feet: { [string]: { any } } = { LeftFoot = {}, RightFoot = {} }
	for frame = 0, frames do
		local time = frame / rate
		local transforms = transformsAt(channels, time)
		local tracked = Pose.track(scan, transforms, identity, Rig.R15_ORDER)
		local placed = Pose.place(scan, transforms, identity)
		for name, part in tracked do
			local depth = floor - part.lowest
			if depth > thresholds.floor_studs and not NOT_FLOORED[name] then
				local entry = below[name]
				if not entry then
					below[name] = { deepest = depth, at = time, first = time, last = time }
				else
					entry.last = time
					if depth > entry.deepest then
						entry.deepest, entry.at = depth, time
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for foot, list in feet do
			-- Where the toe, the heel and the middle of the sole are across the floor.
			local size = joints[foot].part1.Size
			local sole = {}
			for _, along in { -0.5, 0.5, 0 } do
				local point = placed[foot]:PointToWorldSpace(Roblox.Vector3.new(0, -size.Y / 2, along * size.Z))
				table.insert(sole, { point.X, point.Z })
			end
			list[frame + 1] = { lowest = tracked[foot].lowest, position = tracked[foot].position, sole = sole }
		end
	end
	for _, name in Rig.R15_ORDER do
		local entry = below[name]
		if entry then
			report({
				code = "BELOW_FLOOR",
				severity = "warning",
				message = `"{name}" goes {rounded(entry.deepest, 3)} studs into the floor around {milliseconds(
					entry.at
				)} seconds, between {milliseconds(entry.first)} and {milliseconds(entry.last)} seconds. The floor is the rig's lowest point at rest, {rounded(
					-floor,
					3
				)} studs below the root part.`,
				joints = { name },
				time = milliseconds(entry.at),
				time_from = milliseconds(entry.first),
				time_to = milliseconds(entry.last),
				measured = rounded(entry.deepest, 3),
				threshold = thresholds.floor_studs,
				unit = "studs",
			})
		end
	end

	-- A foot touches the floor while its lowest point is within a share of the floor limit
	-- of it (TOUCH): one passing a little above it, as a swing does, is not on it. While
	-- it touches, it should not move across the floor: a foot that moves fast while it
	-- touches is scuffing, as a swinging foot that drags or a planted one that skates; one
	-- that creeps for three frames or more is sliding.
	--
	-- In a looping clip the floor itself may move: a walk or run is usually made on the
	-- spot, its planted feet moving back steadily under the body. How fast is measured from
	-- the clip, as the most common step of a sole on the floor, and a foot's motion is then
	-- judged against the floor's. Each frame is judged by itself, so a swing that skims the
	-- floor fast just before a plant is told from the plant.
	local touch = TOUCH * thresholds.floor_studs
	local looping = (clip :: any).Loop == true
	local count = frames + 1
	local function touching(list: { any }, step: number): boolean
		-- No further above the floor than the touch, and no deeper into it than the floor
		-- limit; deeper is reported as below the floor instead.
		local height = list[step].lowest - floor
		return height <= touch and height >= -thresholds.floor_studs
	end
	-- The step a point of the sole takes from one frame to another, across the floor.
	local function stepOf(list: { any }, from: number, to: number, point: number): (number, number)
		local here, there = list[to].sole[point], list[from].sole[point]
		return here[1] - there[1], here[2] - there[2]
	end

	-- The floor's step each frame: in a looping clip, the middle of every step the soles
	-- take while they touch, across and along; still when that is slower than a creep.
	local floorX, floorZ = 0, 0
	if looping then
		local xs, zs = {}, {}
		for _, list in feet do
			for step = 2, count do
				if touching(list, step) and touching(list, step - 1) then
					for point = 1, 3 do
						local x, z = stepOf(list, step - 1, step, point)
						table.insert(xs, x)
						table.insert(zs, z)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if #xs > 0 then
			table.sort(xs)
			table.sort(zs)
			local middle = (#xs + 1) // 2
			floorX, floorZ = xs[middle], zs[middle]
			if math.sqrt(floorX ^ 2 + floorZ ^ 2) * rate < MOVING_FLOOR then
				floorX, floorZ = 0, 0
			end
		end
	end
	local moving = floorX ~= 0 or floorZ ~= 0

	for _, foot in { "LeftFoot", "RightFoot" } do
		local list = feet[foot]
		-- How fast a foot moves across the floor between two frames, against the floor: as
		-- slow as the point of its sole that moves least, so a foot rolling over its toe or
		-- heel, which stays put, is not moving.
		local function slip(from: number, to: number): number
			local least = math.huge
			for point = 1, 3 do
				local x, z = stepOf(list, from, to, point)
				least = math.min(least, math.sqrt((x - floorX) ^ 2 + (z - floorZ) ^ 2))
			end
			return least * rate
		end
		-- The frames on either side of one; in a looping clip the last frame and the first
		-- are the same moment, so the clip carries on round.
		local function before(step: number): number?
			if step > 1 then
				return step - 1
			end
			return if looping and count > 2 then count - 1 else nil
		end
		local function after(step: number): number?
			if step < count then
				return step + 1
			end
			return if looping and count > 2 then 2 else nil
		end
		-- A frame scuffs when the foot touches and moves fast both coming into it and going
		-- out of it: a foot that lands, or lifts off, moves fast on one side only.
		local function scuffing(step: number): number?
			local speed = math.huge
			local into, out = before(step), after(step)
			if into then
				speed = math.min(speed, slip(into, step))
			end
			if out then
				speed = math.min(speed, slip(step, out))
			end
			return if speed ~= math.huge and speed > SCUFF_SPEED then speed else nil
		end
		local function times(index: number, finish: number): (number, number)
			return (index - 1) / rate, (finish - 1) / rate
		end

		local index = 1
		while index <= count do
			if not touching(list, index) then
				index += 1
				continue
			end
			local finish = index
			while finish + 1 <= count and touching(list, finish + 1) do
				finish += 1
			end
			-- Each run of scuffing frames in the stretch is reported on its own.
			local scuffed = false
			local step = index
			while step <= finish do
				local speed = scuffing(step)
				if not speed then
					step += 1
					continue
				end
				local first, fastest, nearest = step, speed, list[step].lowest - floor
				while step + 1 <= finish do
					local next = scuffing(step + 1)
					if not next then
						break
					end
					step += 1
					fastest = math.max(fastest, next)
					nearest = math.min(nearest, list[step].lowest - floor)
				end
				scuffed = true
				local from, to = times(first, step)
				local against = if moving
					then ` against the floor, which moves {rounded(math.sqrt(floorX ^ 2 + floorZ ^ 2) * rate, 2)} studs a second in this cycle made on the spot`
					else ""
				report({
					code = "FOOT_SCUFF",
					severity = "warning",
					message = `"{foot}" touches the floor from {milliseconds(from)} to {milliseconds(to)} seconds while moving up to {rounded(
						fastest,
						2
					)} studs a second across it{against}, coming within {rounded(nearest, 3)} studs of it: a swinging foot that drags, or a planted one that skates. Lift a swing with clear_floor; plant a foot with pin.`,
					joints = { foot },
					time_from = milliseconds(from),
					time_to = milliseconds(to),
					measured = rounded(fastest, 2),
					threshold = SCUFF_SPEED,
					unit = "studs per second",
				})
				step += 1
			end
			if not scuffed and finish - index >= 2 then
				-- How far it slides against the floor: as far as the point of its sole that
				-- moves least, so a foot rolling over its toe or heel is not sliding.
				local drift = math.huge
				for point = 1, 3 do
					local start = list[index].sole[point]
					local furthest = 0
					for frame = index, finish do
						local here = list[frame].sole[point]
						local carried = frame - index
						local x = here[1] - start[1] - floorX * carried
						local z = here[2] - start[2] - floorZ * carried
						furthest = math.max(furthest, math.sqrt(x ^ 2 + z ^ 2))
					end
					drift = math.min(drift, furthest)
				end
				if drift > thresholds.slide_studs then
					local from, to = times(index, finish)
					report({
						code = "FOOT_SLIDE",
						severity = "warning",
						message = `"{foot}" is on the floor from {milliseconds(from)} to {milliseconds(to)} seconds but slides {rounded(
							drift,
							3
						)} studs along it{if moving
							then " against the floor of this cycle made on the spot"
							else ""}. Pin it with the pin operation to keep it in place.`,
						joints = { foot },
						time_from = milliseconds(from),
						time_to = milliseconds(to),
						measured = rounded(drift, 3),
						threshold = thresholds.slide_studs,
						unit = "studs",
					})
				end
			end
			index = finish + 1
		end
	end
end

-- Findings for a curve clip, in the same form as Validate's. `report` takes each one.
function Contacts.validate(
	clip: Instance,
	joints: { [string]: any },
	nonKinematic: { [string]: boolean }?,
	thresholds: { [string]: number },
	report: (issue: any) -> ()
)
	local duration = Store.duration(clip)
	local byJoint: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
		if #keys == 0 then
			continue
		end
		byJoint[track.joint] = true
		if not joints[track.joint] and track.joint ~= Rig.ROOT then
			report({
				code = "UNKNOWN_JOINT",
				severity = "error",
				message = `There are keys for "{track.joint}", but the rig has no such joint.`,
				joints = { track.joint },
			})
		end
		if #keys > Store.MAX_KEYS then
			report({
				code = "TOO_MANY_KEYS",
				severity = "error",
				message = `{track.path} has {#keys} keys; the most supported is {Store.MAX_KEYS}.`,
				joints = { track.joint },
				measured = #keys,
				threshold = Store.MAX_KEYS,
				unit = "keys",
			})
		end
		for _, key in keys do
			local sound = isFinite(key.value)
				and isFinite(key.time)
				and (key.left == nil or isFinite(key.left))
				and (key.right == nil or isFinite(key.right))
			if not sound then
				report({
					code = "NON_FINITE_TRANSFORM",
					severity = "error",
					message = `A key of {track.path} holds a number that is not finite.`,
					joints = { track.joint },
					time = if isFinite(key.time) then milliseconds(key.time) else nil,
				})
			elseif key.time < 0 or key.time > Store.MAX_TIME then
				report({
					code = "INVALID_KEYFRAME_TIME",
					severity = "error",
					message = `A key of {track.path} is at {key.time} seconds, outside 0 to {Store.MAX_TIME}.`,
					joints = { track.joint },
					measured = key.time,
					threshold = Store.MAX_TIME,
					unit = "seconds",
				})
			elseif track.channel:sub(1, 8) == "position" and math.abs(key.value) > Store.MAX_POSITION then
				report({
					code = "POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE",
					severity = "error",
					message = `A key of {track.path} is {rounded(key.value, 3)} studs from rest.`,
					joints = { track.joint },
					time = milliseconds(key.time),
					measured = rounded(math.abs(key.value), 3),
					threshold = Store.MAX_POSITION,
					unit = "studs",
				})
			end
		end
	end

	-- Keys between frames are never shown as keyed.
	local offFrame, firstOff = 0, nil :: number?
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		for _, key in Store.keys(track.curve) do
			local frames = key.time * Store.FRAME_RATE
			if math.abs(frames - math.round(frames)) * 1000 / Store.FRAME_RATE > Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				offFrame += 1
				firstOff = firstOff or key.time
			end
		end
	end
	if offFrame > 0 then
		report({
			code = "KEY_OFF_FRAME",
			severity = "warning",
			message = `{offFrame} keys are between frames, the first at {milliseconds(firstOff :: number)} seconds. Studio plays a curve clip at {Store.FRAME_RATE} frames a second and goes straight from frame to frame, so these keys are never shown as keyed and sharp moves through them are softened. Put keys on whole frames: multiples of 1/{Store.FRAME_RATE} of a second.`,
			measured = offFrame,
			unit = "keys",
		})
	end

	-- Speed and the loop are measured on the motion itself, at 60 moments a second.
	local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(duration * 60))
	for joint in byJoint do
		if nonKinematic and nonKinematic[joint] then
			report({
				code = "NON_KINEMATIC_JOINT",
				severity = "warning",
				message = `"{joint}" is driven through forces (IsKinematic is off), so what is rendered can differ from the clip.`,
				joints = { joint },
			})
		end
		if duration <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local fastest, at = 0, 0
		local previous = rotationAt(clip, joint, 0)
		for step = 1, steps do
			local time = duration * step / steps
			local now = rotationAt(clip, joint, time)
			local speed = turn(previous, now) / (duration / steps)
			if speed > fastest then
				fastest, at = speed, time
			end
			previous = now
		end
		if fastest > thresholds.speed_degrees_per_second then
			report({
				code = "ABRUPT_ROTATION",
				severity = "warning",
				message = `"{joint}" turns at {rounded(fastest, 1)} degrees per second around {milliseconds(at)} seconds.`,
				joints = { joint },
				time = milliseconds(at),
				measured = rounded(fastest, 1),
				threshold = thresholds.speed_degrees_per_second,
				unit = "degrees per second",
			})
		end
		if (clip :: any).Loop == true then
			local gap = turn(rotationAt(clip, joint, 0), rotationAt(clip, joint, duration))
			if gap > thresholds.loop_rotation_degrees then
				report({
					code = "LOOP_ROTATION_MISMATCH",
					severity = "warning",
					message = `"{joint}" ends {rounded(gap, 3)} degrees from where it starts, so the loop will jump.`,
					joints = { joint },
					time_from = 0,
					time_to = milliseconds(duration),
					measured = rounded(gap, 3),
					threshold = thresholds.loop_rotation_degrees,
					unit = "degrees",
				})
			end
		end
	end

	contacts(clip, joints, thresholds, report)
end

return Contacts

-- Sounds load once they're in the DataModel, report their TimeLength, and
-- a sound that never loads stays "playing" without time passing.
local function sound(id, parent)
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.SoundId = id
    s.Parent = parent
    return s
end

local ogg = sound("rbxasset://sounds/oof.ogg", workspace)
local mp3 = sound("rbxasset://sounds/action_jump.mp3", workspace)
local loose = sound("rbxasset://sounds/oof.ogg", nil)
local missing = sound("rbxasset://sounds/no_such_sound.wav", workspace)
log("before loading", ogg.IsLoaded, ogg.TimeLength)

for _ = 1, 100 do
    if ogg.IsLoaded and mp3.IsLoaded then
        break
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
end
log("ogg", ogg.IsLoaded, string.format("%.6f", ogg.TimeLength))
log("mp3", mp3.IsLoaded, string.format("%.6f", mp3.TimeLength))
log("unparented", loose.IsLoaded, loose.TimeLength)

missing:Play()
mp3:Play()
task.wait(0.15)
log("missing", missing.IsLoaded, missing.Playing, missing.TimePosition)
log("mp3 playing", mp3.Playing, mp3.TimePosition > 0.05)
task.wait(0.5)
-- Past its end (0.34 s): stopped and rewound.
log("mp3 ended", mp3.Playing, mp3.TimePosition)

for _, s in { ogg, mp3, loose, missing } do
    s:Destroy()
end

--!strict
-- Machine.lua -- 486/Pentium-class PC skeleton for RVPC.
--
-- Owns 32-bit physical memory, the CPU, VGA, the 8259/8254/CMOS chipset and
-- optional serial/parallel ports. Host services are injected through deps; this
-- module never requires Roblox or the filesystem.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Machine = {}
Machine.__index = Machine

const PIC_MASTER_CMD = 0x20
const PIC_MASTER_DATA = 0x21
const PIC_SLAVE_CMD = 0xA0
const PIC_SLAVE_DATA = 0xA1
const PIT_BASE = 0x40
const CMOS_INDEX = 0x70
const CMOS_DATA = 0x71
const PORT_A20 = 0x92
const DEVICE_BATCH = 8
const PCI_ADDRESS = 0xCF8
const PCI_DATA = 0xCFC
-- The ISP side must not share the guest NIC's default MAC (52:54:00:12:34:56).
const DEFAULT_ISP_MAC = "52:54:00:12:34:57"

export type Deps = {
	Memory: any,
	Cpu: any,
	Vga: any?,
	Pic: any?,
	Pit: any?,
	Cmos: any?,
	FwCfg: any?,
	Ide: any?,
	Kbc: any?,
	Fpu: any?,
	Dma: any?,
	Sb16: any?,
	Fdc: any?,
	Ne2000: any?,
	Isp: any?,
	Xms: any?,
	Uart: any?,
	Lpt: any?,
}

export type NetworkConfig = {
	mac: string?,
	ispMac: string?,
	ip: string?,
	enabled: boolean?,
}

export type FloppyConfig = {
	image: buffer?,
	writeProtected: boolean?,
	dirty: ((drive: number, lba: number, count: number) -> ())?,
}

export type Config = {
	memorySize: number?,
	-- Keep SeaBIOS's "$PnP" installation header visible (default false: it is
	-- hidden). SeaBIOS's PnP BIOS answers every node call with
	-- FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, so a guest that finds it (Win9x) trusts it to
	-- report the PCI bus, gets nothing, and never enumerates PCI. Without the
	-- header Win9x falls back to legacy detection, which finds the PCI bus.
	pnpBios: boolean?,
	cpu: any?,
	serial: any?,
	printer: any?,
	timerInterval: number?,
	rom: buffer?,
	vgaRom: buffer?,
	hdd: buffer?,
	cdrom: buffer?,
	hdd2: buffer?,
	cdrom2: buffer?,
	floppy: FloppyConfig?,
	floppy1: FloppyConfig?,
	network: NetworkConfig?,
	audioSink: ((samples: buffer) -> ())?,
}

export type Machine = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		mem: any,
		cpu: any,
		vga: any?,
		pic: any?,
		pit: any?,
		cmos: any?,
		rtcState: any?,
		fwcfg: any?,
		ide: any?,
		ide2: any?,
		kbc: any?,
		fpu: any?,
		dma: any?,
		sb16: any?,
		fdc: any?,
		ne2000: any?,
		isp: any?,
		xms: any?,
		uart: any?,
		lpt: any?,
		exitCode: number?,
		config: Config,
		pciAddress: number,
		vgaBar: number,
		vgaCommand: number,
		vgaLatency: number,
		vgaRomBar: number,
		vgaRomBarProbe: boolean,
		vgaInterruptLine: number,
		ideBars: { number },
		ideBarProbe: { boolean },
		ideCommand: number,
		ideLatency: number,
		-- PIIX3 IDETIM (0x40 primary, 0x42 secondary) and SIDETIM (0x44): bit 15
		-- of each IDETIM word is the channel's IDE decode enable.
		ideTiming: number,
		ideSlaveTiming: number,
		isaConfig: { [number]: number },
		isaCommand: number,
		elcrMaster: number,
		elcrSlave: number,
		sb16Clock: number,
		ppi: number,
		lastInPort: number,
		lastOutPort: number,
		lastOutValue: number,
		irqCount: number,
		int19Count: number,
		-- Guest instructions retired per PIT/RTC clock tick (1 = the historic
		-- one-instruction-per-timer-cycle pacing, ~1 MIPS against the 1.19 MHz
		-- PIT). Win98 SETUP benchmarks IDIV against PIT channel 2 and refuses
		-- CPUs below 66 MHz, so hosts running it set 2 or more.
		timerDivisor: number,
		devPhase: number,
		timerPhase: number,
		atResetVector: boolean,
		booted: boolean,
		debugLog: { string },
		run: (self: Machine, maxSteps: number?) -> number,
		reset: (self: Machine) -> (),
		outputText: (self: Machine) -> string,
		debugText: (self: Machine) -> string,
		bootPc: (self: Machine) -> string,
		deliverInterrupt: (self: Machine) -> boolean,
		pressKey: (self: Machine, scancode: number) -> (),
		releaseKey: (self: Machine, scancode: number) -> (),
		mouseMove: (self: Machine, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?) -> (),
		injectBdaKey: (self: Machine, scan: number, ascii: number) -> boolean,
	},
	Machine
))

-- A tiny 440FX host bridge so SeaBIOS's northbridge probe finds something
-- plausible. There is no real PCI device behind it yet; absent devices read as
-- all-ones, which is what the configuration mechanism reports on an empty bus.
local function hostBridgeDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x12378086 -- Intel 440FX, vendor 8086 device 1237
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return 0x00000006 -- I/O + memory space enabled
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x06000002 -- host bridge, revision 2
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4 -- Red Hat/QEMU subsystem, as SeaBIOS expects
	end
	-- PAM/PAM shadow-control bytes are written by SeaBIOS's
	-- make_bios_writable/make_bios_readonly paths.
	return machine.hostConfig[offset] or 0
end

-- Bochs/QEMU stdvga-compatible PCI VGA device at 00:02.0. The VGA BIOS option
-- ROM at C0000 is what installs INT 10h; the legacy VGA register model lives in
-- core/Vga.lua. BAR0 is intentionally absent (no linear framebuffer yet).
local function configDword(config: { [number]: number }, offset: number): number
	local value = 0
	for index = 0, 3 do
		value = bor(value, lshift(band(config[offset + index] or 0, 0xFF), index * 8))
	end
	return value
end

local function vgaDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x11111234 -- Bochs VGA, vendor 1234 device 1111
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.vgaCommand or 7, 0xFFFF), 0x02000000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x03000001 -- VGA controller, revision 1
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header
	elseif offset == 0x10 then
		return machine.vgaBar
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4
	elseif offset == 0x30 then
		if machine.vgaRomBarProbe then
			return 0xFFFFF800
		end
		return machine.vgaRomBar or 0
	elseif offset == 0x3C then
		-- Route VGA through the slot's INTC link (PIRQD on this PIIX3 table)
		-- so the $PIR link and the VGA interrupt line both resolve to IRQ 11.
		return bor(band(machine.vgaInterruptLine or 11, 0xFF), 0x0300)
	elseif offset == 0x40 then
		return band(machine.vgaLatency or 0, 0xFF)
	end
	return 0
end

-- PIIX3 topology: ISA bridge at 00:01.0 (multifunction), IDE at 00:01.1.
-- The IDE function advertises bus-master capability (prog_if 0x80) while both
-- channels remain in legacy mode, so SeaBIOS and the Win98 PIIX3 driver use
-- 0x1F0/0x3F6/IRQ14 and 0x170/0x376/IRQ15.
const IDE_BAR_DEFAULTS = { 0x1F0, 0x3F6, 0x170, 0x376, 0xC000 }
const IDE_BAR_SIZES = { 8, 2, 8, 2, 16 }

local function isaBridgeDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x70008086 -- Intel PIIX3 ISA bridge
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.isaCommand or 0x0007, 0xFFFF), 0x02000000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x06010000 -- ISA bridge, revision 0
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00800000 -- header type 0x80: multifunction device
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4 -- Red Hat/QEMU subsystem
	end
	return configDword(machine.isaConfig or {}, offset)
end

local function ideBarMask(index: number): number
	return bit32.bnot(IDE_BAR_SIZES[index] - 1)
end

local function ideBarDword(machine: any, index: number): number
	const mask = ideBarMask(index)
	if machine.ideBarProbe[index] then
		return bor(mask, 1)
	end
	const base = machine.ideBars[index] or IDE_BAR_DEFAULTS[index]
	return bor(band(base, mask), 1)
end

local function ideDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x70108086 -- Intel PIIX3 IDE
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.ideCommand or 0x00000007, 0xFFFF), 0x02800000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x01018000 -- IDE controller, bus-master programming interface
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header, single function
	elseif offset >= 0x10 and offset <= 0x20 and band(offset, 3) == 0 then
		const index = math.floor((offset - 0x10) / 4) + 1
		return ideBarDword(machine, index)
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4
	elseif offset == 0x3C then
		return 0x0000010E -- interrupt line 14, INTA#
	elseif offset == 0x40 then
		return machine.ideTiming or 0
	elseif offset == 0x44 then
		return band(machine.ideSlaveTiming or 0, 0xFF)
	end
	return 0
end

local function pciRead(machine: any, address: number): number
	if band(address, 0x80000000) == 0 then
		return 0xFFFFFFFF
	end
	const bus = band(rshift(address, 16), 0xFF)
	const device = band(rshift(address, 11), 0x1F)
	const functionNumber = band(rshift(address, 8), 0x07)
	const offset = band(address, 0xFC)
	if bus == 0 then
		if device == 0 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return hostBridgeDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 1 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return isaBridgeDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 1 and functionNumber == 1 then
			return ideDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 2 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return vgaDword(machine, offset)
		end
	end
	return 0xFFFFFFFF
end

local function pciWrite(machine: any, address: number, value: number)
	if band(address, 0x80000000) == 0 then
		return
	end
	const bus = band(rshift(address, 16), 0xFF)
	const device = band(rshift(address, 11), 0x1F)
	const functionNumber = band(rshift(address, 8), 0x07)
	const offset = band(address, 0xFC)
	if bus == 0 and device == 2 and functionNumber == 0 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.vgaCommand = band(value, 0xFFFF)
		elseif offset == 0x10 then
			-- VGA LFB BAR0: 4 MiB memory BAR at 0xE0000000.
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.vgaBar = 0xFFC00000
			else
				machine.vgaBar = band(value, 0xFFC00000)
			end
		elseif offset == 0x30 then
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.vgaRomBarProbe = true
			else
				machine.vgaRomBarProbe = false
				machine.vgaRomBar = bor(band(value, 0xFFFFF800), band(value, 1))
			end
		elseif offset == 0x3C then
			machine.vgaInterruptLine = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 0x40 then
			machine.vgaLatency = band(value, 0xFF)
		end
		return
	end
	if bus == 0 and device == 1 and functionNumber == 0 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.isaCommand = band(value, 0xFFFF)
		elseif offset == 0x3C then
			machine.isaConfig[0x3C] = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif offset >= 0x40 then
			for index = 0, 3 do
				machine.isaConfig[offset + index] = band(rshift(value, index * 8), 0xFF)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if bus == 0 and device == 1 and functionNumber == 1 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.ideCommand = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
			return
		end
		if offset >= 0x10 and offset <= 0x20 and band(offset, 3) == 0 then
			const index = math.floor((offset - 0x10) / 4) + 1
			const mask = ideBarMask(index)
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.ideBarProbe[index] = true
				return
			end
			machine.ideBarProbe[index] = false
			const base = band(value, mask)
			machine.ideBars[index] = base
			if index == 5 then
				if machine.ide then
					machine.ide.bmBase = base
				end
				if machine.ide2 then
					machine.ide2.bmBase = base + 8
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if offset == 0x40 then
			machine.ideTiming = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
		elseif offset == 0x44 then
			machine.ideSlaveTiming = band(value, 0xFF)
		end
		return
	end
	if bus ~= 0 or device ~= 0 or functionNumber ~= 0 then
		return
	end
	if offset == 0x58 or offset == 0x5C then
		machine.hostConfig[offset] = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
		-- PAM0 bit 4 set with read-only encoding (0x10/0x11) is SeaBIOS's
		-- "make_bios_readonly" state for F0000-FFFFF.
		const pam0 = band(rshift(machine.hostConfig[0x58] or 0, 8), 0xFF)
		machine.mem:lockLowRom(band(pam0, 0x30) == 0x10)
	end
end

-- Overwrite the signature of every PnP BIOS installation header ("$PnP",
-- paragraph aligned, version 1.0, length 0x21) in buf[start, start+length).
-- Returns how many headers were hidden.
function Machine.hidePnpHeader(buf: buffer, start: number, length: number): number
	local hidden = 0
	local offset = start + -start % 16
	while offset + 0x21 <= start + length do
		if
			buffer.readu32(buf, offset) == 0x506E5024 -- "$PnP"
			and buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 4) == 0x10
			and buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 5) == 0x21
		then
			buffer.writeu32(buf, offset, 0x506F4E24) -- "$NoP"
			hidden += 1
		end
		offset += 16
	end
	return hidden
end

function Machine.new(deps: Deps, config: Config?): Machine
	const cfg: Config = config or {}
	local self = setmetatable({}, Machine) :: any
	self.config = cfg
	self.mem = deps.Memory.new(cfg.memorySize or (16 * 1024 * 1024))
	if cfg.rom then
		local rom = cfg.rom
		if not cfg.pnpBios then
			rom = buffer.create(buffer.len(cfg.rom))
			buffer.copy(rom, 0, cfg.rom)
			Machine.hidePnpHeader(rom, 0, buffer.len(rom))
		end
		self.mem:loadRom(rom)
	end
	if cfg.vgaRom then
		self.mem:loadOptionRom(cfg.vgaRom, 0xC0000)
	end
	if deps.Vga then
		self.vga = deps.Vga.new(self.mem)
		self.mem.aperture = self.vga
	end
	if deps.Pic then
		self.pic = deps.Pic.new()
	end
	if deps.Pit then
		self.pit = deps.Pit.new()
	end
	if deps.Cmos then
		local floppyType = 0
		if cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.image then
			floppyType = bor(floppyType, 0x40) -- drive A: 1.44M
		end
		if cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.image then
			floppyType = bor(floppyType, 0x04) -- drive B: 1.44M
		end
		-- Primary master disk geometry as IDENTIFY reports it (16 heads, 63
		-- sectors, cylinders from the image size, capped at 16383).
		local hardDisks = {}
		if cfg.hdd then
			const total = math.floor(buffer.len(cfg.hdd) / 512)
			hardDisks[1] = {
				cylinders = math.max(1, math.min(16383, math.floor(total / (16 * 63)))),
				heads = 16,
				sectors = 63,
			}
		end
		const cmos = deps.Cmos.new({
			memorySize = self.mem.size,
			floppyType = floppyType,
			hardDisks = hardDisks,
		})
		self.cmos = cmos
		self.rtcState = cmos.rtc
	end
	if deps.FwCfg then
		self.fwcfg = deps.FwCfg.new(self.mem.size, cfg.vgaRom)
	end
	if deps.Ide then
		self.ide = deps.Ide.new({
			hdd = cfg.hdd,
			cdrom = cfg.cdrom,
			mem = self.mem,
			bmBase = 0xC000,
		})
		self.ide2 = deps.Ide.new({
			hdd = cfg.hdd2,
			cdrom = cfg.cdrom2,
			base = 0x170,
			altBase = 0x376,
			irq = deps.Ide.IRQ_SECONDARY or 15,
			mem = self.mem,
			bmBase = 0xC008,
		})
	end
	const network = cfg.network
	const networkEnabled = network == nil or network.enabled ~= false
	if deps.Ne2000 and networkEnabled then
		self.ne2000 = deps.Ne2000.new({ mac = if network then network.mac else nil })
	end
	if deps.Isp and networkEnabled then
		local ispMac = if network then network.ispMac else nil
		if not ispMac and self.ne2000 then
			ispMac = DEFAULT_ISP_MAC
		end
		self.isp = deps.Isp.new({ mac = ispMac, ip = if network then network.ip else nil })
		if self.ne2000 then
			self.isp:attach(self.ne2000)
		end
	end
	if deps.Kbc then
		self.kbc = deps.Kbc.new()
	end
	if deps.Fpu then
		self.fpu = deps.Fpu.new()
	end
	if deps.Dma then
		self.dma = deps.Dma.new({
			read8 = function(address: number): number
				return self.mem:read8(address)
			end,
			read16 = function(address: number): number
				return self.mem:read16(address)
			end,
			write8 = function(address: number, value: number)
				self.mem:write8(address, value)
			end,
			write16 = function(address: number, value: number)
				self.mem:write16(address, value)
			end,
		})
	end
	if deps.Fdc then
		self.fdc = deps.Fdc.new({
			floppy = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.image,
			floppy1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.image,
			writeProtected = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.writeProtected,
			writeProtected1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.writeProtected,
			dirty = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.dirty,
			dirty1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.dirty,
			dma = self.dma,
		})
	end
	if deps.Sb16 then
		self.sb16 = deps.Sb16.new({
			dma = self.dma,
			dmaChannel = 1,
			irq = 5,
			sink = cfg.audioSink or function(_samples: buffer) end,
		})
	end
	if deps.Uart then
		self.uart = deps.Uart.new(cfg.serial)
	end
	if deps.Lpt then
		self.lpt = deps.Lpt.new(cfg.printer)
	end
	self.pciAddress = 0
	self.vgaBar = 0xE0000000
	self.ideBars = { 0x1F0, 0x3F6, 0x170, 0x376, 0xC000 }
	self.ideBarProbe = { false, false, false, false, false }
	self.ideCommand = 0x00000007
	self.ideLatency = 0
	-- Both channels decode, as SeaBIOS programs them (and as checkpoints taken
	-- after POST need): Win98 reads the enables to decide which channels the
	-- protected-mode IDE driver gets; with them clear it falls back to
	-- MS-DOS compatibility mode for every drive.
	self.ideTiming = 0x80008000
	self.ideSlaveTiming = 0
	self.vgaCommand = 0x00000007
	self.vgaLatency = 0
	self.vgaRomBar = 0x000C0001 -- 32 KiB option ROM in the C0000 shadow window
	self.vgaRomBarProbe = false
	self.vgaInterruptLine = 11
	self.isaCommand = 0x00000007
	self.isaConfig = {}
	for index = 0, 0xFF do
		self.isaConfig[index] = 0
	end
	-- PIIX3 reset defaults: PIRQ[A-D] disabled until the firmware routes them.
	for index = 0x60, 0x63 do
		self.isaConfig[index] = 0x80
	end
	self.isaConfig[0x4E] = 0x03
	self.isaConfig[0x4F] = 0x00
	self.isaConfig[0x69] = 0x02
	self.isaConfig[0x70] = 0x80
	self.elcrMaster = 0
	self.elcrSlave = 0
	self.sb16Clock = 0
	self.ppi = 0
	self.hostConfig = {}
	self.lastInPort = 0
	self.lastOutPort = 0
	self.lastOutValue = 0
	self.irqCount = 0
	self.int19Count = 0
	self.timerDivisor = 1
	self.devPhase = 0
	self.timerPhase = 0
	self.atResetVector = false
	self.booted = false
	self.debugLog = {}

	local function pciAddressByte(index: number): number
		return band(rshift(self.pciAddress, index * 8), 0xFF)
	end
	local function pciDataByte(index: number): number
		return band(rshift(pciRead(self, self.pciAddress), index * 8), 0xFF)
	end

	local io: any
	io = {
		in8 = function(port: number): number
			self.lastInPort = port
			if self.fwcfg and (port == 0x510 or port == 0x511) then
				return self.fwcfg:in8(port)
			end
			if
				self.dma
				and (
					port <= 0x0F
					or (port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF)
					or port == 0x81
					or port == 0x82
					or port == 0x83
					or port == 0x87
					or port == 0x89
					or port == 0x8A
					or port == 0x8B
				)
			then
				return self.dma:in8(port)
			end
			if
				self.sb16
				and ((port >= 0x220 and port <= 0x22F) or port == 0x388 or port == 0x389)
			then
				return self.sb16:in8(port)
			end
			if self.kbc and (port == 0x60 or port == 0x64) then
				return self.kbc:in8(port)
			end
			if self.fdc and ((port >= 0x3F0 and port <= 0x3F5) or port == 0x3F7) then
				return self.fdc:in8(port)
			end
			if self.ide and ((port >= 0x1F0 and port <= 0x1F7) or port == 0x3F6) then
				return self.ide:in8(port)
			end
			if self.ide2 and ((port >= 0x170 and port <= 0x177) or port == 0x376) then
				return self.ide2:in8(port)
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn8(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn8(port)
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				return self.ne2000:in8(port)
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF or port == 0x1D0) then
				return self.vga:in8(port)
			end
			if self.vga and port >= 0x3C0 and port <= 0x3DF then
				return self.vga:in8(port)
			end
			if port == 0x4D0 then
				return self.elcrMaster
			elseif port == 0x4D1 then
				return self.elcrSlave
			end
			if
				self.pic
				and (
					port == PIC_MASTER_CMD
					or port == PIC_MASTER_DATA
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_CMD
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_DATA
				)
			then
				return self.pic:in8(port)
			end
			if self.pit and port >= PIT_BASE and port <= PIT_BASE + 3 then
				return self.pit:in8(port)
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_INDEX then
				return self.cmos:in8(port)
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_DATA then
				return self.cmos:in8(port)
			end
			if port == PORT_A20 then
				return if self.mem.a20 then 0x02 else 0x00
			end
			if port == 0x61 then
				-- PPI port B: bits 0/1 are the speaker gate/data latch; bit 4
				-- is the refresh toggle and bit 5 the timer-2 output. The AIC
				-- ASPI delay loop only needs bit 4 to keep changing; the BIOS
				-- TSC calibration waits on bit 5, so it must follow PIT 2.
				local tsc = self.cpu and self.cpu.tsc or 0
				return bor(
					band(self.ppi, 0x03),
					if band(rshift(tsc, 4), 1) ~= 0 then 0x10 else 0,
					if self.pit and self.pit.channels[3].output then 0x20 else 0
				)
			end
			if port >= PCI_ADDRESS and port <= PCI_ADDRESS + 3 then
				return pciAddressByte(port - PCI_ADDRESS)
			end
			if port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 3 then
				return pciDataByte(port - PCI_DATA)
			end
			if self.uart and port >= 0x3F8 and port <= 0x3FF then
				return self.uart:in8(port)
			end
			if self.lpt and port >= 0x378 and port <= 0x37A then
				return self.lpt:in8(port)
			end
			return 0xFF
		end,
		in16 = function(port: number): number
			if self.fwcfg and port == 0x510 then
				return self.fwcfg:in16(port)
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				return self.ide:in16(port)
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				return self.ide2:in16(port)
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn16(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn16(port)
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				return self.ne2000:in16(port)
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF) then
				return self.vga:in16(port)
			end
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				return band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFF)
			elseif port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 2 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				return band(
					rshift(pciRead(self, band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)), lane * 8),
					0xFFFF
				)
			end
			return bor(io.in8(port), lshift(io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8))
		end,
		in32 = function(port: number): number
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				return self.pciAddress
			elseif port == PCI_DATA then
				return pciRead(self, self.pciAddress)
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				return bor(self.ide:in16(port), lshift(self.ide:in16(port), 16))
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				return bor(self.ide2:in16(port), lshift(self.ide2:in16(port), 16))
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn32(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn32(port)
			end
			return bor(
				io.in8(port),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF)), 16),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF)), 24)
			)
		end,
		out8 = function(port: number, value: number)
			self.lastOutPort = port
			self.lastOutValue = value
			if port == 0x402 then
				-- QEMU/SeaBIOS debug console (CONFIG_DEBUG_PORT).
				self.debugLog[#self.debugLog + 1] = string.char(band(value, 0xFF))
				return
			end
			if self.fwcfg and (port == 0x510 or port == 0x511) then
				self.fwcfg:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if
				self.dma
				and (
					port <= 0x0F
					or (port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF)
					or port == 0x81
					or port == 0x82
					or port == 0x83
					or port == 0x87
					or port == 0x89
					or port == 0x8A
					or port == 0x8B
				)
			then
				self.dma:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if
				self.sb16
				and ((port >= 0x220 and port <= 0x22F) or port == 0x388 or port == 0x389)
			then
				self.sb16:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.kbc and (port == 0x60 or port == 0x64) then
				const kbc = self.kbc
				kbc:out8(port, value)
				if kbc.a20Request ~= nil then
					self.mem:setA20(kbc.a20Request)
					kbc.a20Request = nil
				end
				if kbc.resetRequested then
					kbc.resetRequested = false
					self:reset()
				end
				return
			end
			if self.fdc and ((port >= 0x3F0 and port <= 0x3F5) or port == 0x3F7) then
				self.fdc:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and ((port >= 0x1F0 and port <= 0x1F7) or port == 0x3F6) then
				self.ide:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and ((port >= 0x170 and port <= 0x177) or port == 0x376) then
				self.ide2:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				self.ne2000:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF or port == 0x1D0) then
				self.vga:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and port >= 0x3C0 and port <= 0x3DF then
				self.vga:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if port == 0x4D0 then
				self.elcrMaster = band(value, 0xFF)
				return
			elseif port == 0x4D1 then
				self.elcrSlave = band(value, 0xFF)
				return
			end
			if
				self.pic
				and (
					port == PIC_MASTER_CMD
					or port == PIC_MASTER_DATA
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_CMD
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_DATA
				)
			then
				self.pic:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.pit and port >= PIT_BASE and port <= PIT_BASE + 3 then
				self.pit:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_INDEX then
				self.cmos:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_DATA then
				if self.cmos:out8(port, value) and self.pic then
					-- Enabling an interrupt whose status C flag is already set
					-- raises IRQ8 immediately, as on the real RTC.
					self.pic:raise(8)
				end
				return
			end
			if port == PORT_A20 then
				self.mem:setA20(band(value, 0x02) ~= 0)
				if band(value, 0x01) ~= 0 then
					self:reset()
				end
				return
			end
			if port == 0x61 then
				self.ppi = band(value, 0x03)
				return
			end
			if port >= PCI_ADDRESS and port <= PCI_ADDRESS + 3 then
				return
			end
			if port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 3 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				const address = band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)
				const old = pciRead(self, address)
				const shift = lane * 8
				const mask = lshift(0xFF, shift)
				const updated = bor(band(old, bit32.bnot(mask)), lshift(band(value, 0xFF), shift))
				pciWrite(self, address, updated)
				return
			end
			if self.uart and port >= 0x3F8 and port <= 0x3FF then
				self.uart:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.lpt and port >= 0x378 and port <= 0x37A then
				self.lpt:out8(port, value)
			end
		end,
		out16 = function(port: number, value: number)
			if self.fwcfg and port == 0x510 then
				self.fwcfg:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				self.ide:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				self.ide2:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				self.ne2000:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF) then
				self.vga:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				self.pciAddress = bor(band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFF0000), band(value, 0xFFFF))
				return
			elseif port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 2 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				const address = band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)
				const old = pciRead(self, address)
				const shift = lane * 8
				const mask = lshift(0xFFFF, shift)
				pciWrite(
					self,
					address,
					bor(band(old, bit32.bnot(mask)), lshift(band(value, 0xFFFF), shift))
				)
				return
			end
			io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		end,
		out32 = function(port: number, value: number)
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				self.pciAddress = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
				return
			elseif port == PCI_DATA then
				pciWrite(self, self.pciAddress, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				self.ide:out16(port, band(value, 0xFFFF))
				self.ide:out16(port, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				self.ide2:out16(port, band(value, 0xFFFF))
				self.ide2:out16(port, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut32(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut32(port, value)
				return
			end
			io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 24), 0xFF))
		end,
	}
	const cpuConfig = cfg.cpu or { cpuLevel = "486" }
	if self.fpu then
		cpuConfig.fpu = self.fpu
	end
	self.cpu = deps.Cpu.new(self.mem, io, cpuConfig)
	self.cpu:reset()
	if not self.mem:hasRom() then
		-- Hypervisor fallback for the DOS-era unit tests: every vector returns
		-- until the guest installs its own handler, and XMS can hook INT 2Fh.
		self.mem:write8(0xF0000 + 0x100, 0xCF)
		for vector = 0, 255 do
			self.mem:write16(vector * 4, 0x0100)
			self.mem:write16(vector * 4 + 2, 0xF000)
		end
		if deps.Xms then
			self.xms = deps.Xms.new(self)
		end
	end
	self.exitCode = nil
	return self
end

function Machine.reset(self: Machine)
	self.cpu:reset()
	self.mem:setA20(false)
	self.mem:lockLowRom(false)
	if self.pic then
		self.pic:reset()
	end
	if self.pit then
		self.pit:reset()
	end
	if self.ide then
		self.ide:reset()
	end
	if self.ide2 then
		self.ide2:reset()
	end
	if self.ne2000 then
		self.ne2000:reset()
	end
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:reset()
	end
	if self.dma then
		self.dma:reset()
	end
	if self.fdc then
		self.fdc:reset()
	end
	if self.sb16 then
		self.sb16:resetDsp()
	end
	self.sb16Clock = 0
	self.ppi = 0
	self.exitCode = nil
end

function Machine.deliverInterrupt(self: Machine): boolean
	if not self.pic then
		return false
	end
	if band(self.cpu.flags, 0x200) == 0 or self.cpu.irqDelay > 0 then
		return false
	end
	const vector = self.pic:nextPending()
	if vector == nil then
		return false
	end
	self.pic:acknowledge()
	self.cpu.halted = false
	self.irqCount += 1
	self.cpu:interrupt(vector, nil, false)
	return true
end

local function resetIdeChannels(self: Machine)
	if self.ide then
		self.ide:reset()
	end
	if self.ide2 then
		self.ide2:reset()
	end
end

function Machine.run(self: Machine, maxSteps: number?): number
	local steps = 0
	local idle = 0
	const budget = maxSteps or math.huge
	const cpu = self.cpu
	const pic = self.pic
	const pit = self.pit
	const kbc = self.kbc
	const ide = self.ide
	const ide2 = self.ide2
	const ne2000 = self.ne2000
	const sb16 = self.sb16
	const fdc = self.fdc
	const cmos = self.cmos
	const timerDivisor = self.timerDivisor
	local timerPhase = self.timerPhase
	local devPhase = self.devPhase
	-- The step loop runs under one pcall instead of one per instruction: a
	-- guest fault that must unwind a half-executed instruction (#GP/#PF raised
	-- from a memory access) throws the CPU's abort token, which retires that
	-- instruction here and resumes the loop.
	const abortToken = cpu.abortToken
	local function stepLoop()
		while steps < budget and not self.exitCode do
			devPhase += 1
			-- Devices are serviced every DEVICE_BATCH steps and on the first step of
			-- each run() call; `pending` steps are accounted to the timers at once.
			if devPhase >= DEVICE_BATCH or steps == 0 then
				const pending = devPhase
				devPhase = 0
				timerPhase += pending
				if timerPhase >= timerDivisor then
					const ticks = timerPhase // timerDivisor
					timerPhase -= ticks * timerDivisor
					if pit then
						if pit:advance(ticks) and pic then
							pic:raise(0)
						end
					end
					-- MC146818 clock and interrupt engine. The periodic tick is what
					-- SeaBIOS INT 15h/AH=86h counts down; update/alarm events raise
					-- IRQ8 through the same status C/IRQF path.
					if cmos then
						if cmos:advance(ticks) and pic then
							pic:raise(8)
						end
					end
				end
				-- Retire pending PIO write completions (BSY -> DRDY + INTRQ) so guest
				-- drivers observe the device-busy commit period of a real device.
				for _ = 1, pending do
					if ide and ide.writeDoneCycles > 0 then
						ide:advance()
					end
					if ide2 and ide2.writeDoneCycles > 0 then
						ide2:advance()
					end
				end
				if pic then
					-- Each takeIrq is side-effect free unless its own pending/armed
					-- field is set, so those fields are a cheap equivalent gate.
					if kbc then
						if kbc.irq1Armed and kbc:takeIrq1() then
							pic:raise(1)
						end
						if kbc.irq12Armed and kbc:takeIrq12() then
							pic:raise(12)
						end
					end
					if ide and ide.irqPending and ide:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(14)
					end
					if ide2 and ide2.irqPending and ide2:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(15)
					end
					if ne2000 and (ne2000.irqLine or band(ne2000.isr, ne2000.imr) ~= 0) then
						if ne2000:takeIrq() then
							pic:raise(10)
						end
					end
					if sb16 and sb16.irqPending and sb16:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(5)
					end
					if fdc and fdc.irqPending and fdc:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(6)
					end
					self.sb16Clock += pending
					if sb16 and self.sb16Clock % 1024 < pending then
						sb16:tick()
					end
				end
			end
			if cpu.halted then
				-- The TSC is a free-running counter. BIOS timer waits (notably
				-- INT 15h/AH=86h) use it to measure elapsed time; if it only
				-- advanced on retired instructions, a halted CPU would make those
				-- waits effectively infinite.
				if cpu.tsc then
					cpu.tsc += 1
				end
				if not self:deliverInterrupt() then
					idle += 1
					-- Nothing can wake the CPU before the next timer edge: skip to
					-- just before it in one go. Device service treats the skipped
					-- steps as one pending batch, exactly as it does for 8 steps.
					if pit then
						const leap = math.min(pit:stepsToIrq0() - 1, budget - steps - 1, 65535)
						if leap > 0 then
							steps += leap
							devPhase += leap
							idle += leap
							if cpu.tsc then
								cpu.tsc += leap
							end
						end
					end
					-- A halted CPU waits for the next timer tick; give a full 8254
					-- period (up to 65536 counts) before declaring the machine dead.
					if idle > 200000 then
						break
					end
				else
					idle = 0
				end
			else
				if
					pic
					and pic.master.irr ~= 0
					and band(cpu.flags, 0x200) ~= 0
					and cpu.irqDelay == 0
				then
					self:deliverInterrupt()
				end
				-- step() only wraps executeStep in tracing/paging support; skip the
				-- extra call in the common unpaged, untraced case.
				if not cpu.traceEnabled then
					cpu:executeStep()
					cpu.opActive = false
				else
					cpu:step()
				end
				idle = 0
			end
			-- A guest warm boot can re-enter the BIOS via INT 19h or the reset
			-- vector without asserting IDE SRST. Reset the channels so a stale
			-- OAKCDROM probe error cannot hide the HDD from the next boot's
			-- SeaBIOS drive scan.
			if devPhase == 0 then
				-- Only just serviced: INT 19h is rare, so sample it per device pass.
				const int19 = cpu.intCounts[0x19] or 0
				if int19 > self.int19Count then
					self.int19Count = int19
					resetIdeChannels(self)
				end
			end
			const atResetVector = cpu.ip == 0xFFF0 and cpu.cs == 0xF000
			if atResetVector or self.atResetVector then
				if self.booted and atResetVector and not self.atResetVector then
					resetIdeChannels(self)
				end
				self.atResetVector = atResetVector
			end
			if not self.booted and not atResetVector then
				self.booted = true
			end
			steps += 1
		end
	end
	while true do
		const ok, err = pcall(stepLoop)
		if ok then
			break
		end
		if err ~= abortToken then
			error(err, 0)
		end
		cpu.aborting = false
		steps += 1
		idle = 0
	end
	-- Flush steps still pending since the last device pass so the timers stay
	-- exact at every run() boundary (IRQs raised here deliver on the next step).
	if devPhase > 0 then
		timerPhase += devPhase
		devPhase = 0
		if timerPhase >= timerDivisor then
			const ticks = timerPhase // timerDivisor
			timerPhase -= ticks * timerDivisor
			if pit and pit:advance(ticks) and pic then
				pic:raise(0)
			end
			if cmos and cmos:advance(ticks) and pic then
				pic:raise(8)
			end
		end
	end
	self.timerPhase = timerPhase
	self.devPhase = devPhase
	return steps
end

function Machine.bootPc(self: Machine): string
	return ("%04X:%08X"):format(self.cpu.cs, self.cpu.ip)
end

function Machine.debugText(self: Machine): string
	return table.concat(self.debugLog)
end

function Machine.pressKey(self: Machine, scancode: number)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:pressKey(scancode)
	end
end

function Machine.releaseKey(self: Machine, scancode: number)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:releaseKey(scancode)
	end
end

function Machine.mouseMove(self: Machine, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:mouseMove(dx, dy, buttons)
	end
end

-- Diagnostic input path for harnesses that need to drive SeaBIOS before its
-- own PS/2 IRQ handler is installed. Real host input should use pressKey.
function Machine.injectBdaKey(self: Machine, scan: number, ascii: number): boolean
	const head = self.mem:read16(0x41A)
	const tail = self.mem:read16(0x41C)
	local next = tail + 2
	if next > 0x3D then
		next = 0x1E
	end
	if next == head then
		return false
	end
	self.mem:write16(0x400 + tail, bor(band(ascii, 0xFF), lshift(band(scan, 0xFF), 8)))
	self.mem:write16(0x41C, next)
	return true
end

function Machine.outputText(self: Machine): string
	const vga = self.vga
	if not vga or not vga:isTextMode() then
		return ""
	end
	const rows: { string } = {}
	local lastNonEmpty = 0
	for row = 0, 24 do
		const chars: { string } = {}
		for column = 0, 79 do
			const cell = 0xB8000 + (row * 80 + column) * 2
			const code = self.mem:read8(cell)
			chars[column + 1] = string.char(if code >= 32 and code < 127 then code else 32)
		end
		local line = table.concat(chars)
		line = string.gsub(line, "%s+$", "")
		rows[row + 1] = line
		if #line > 0 then
			lastNonEmpty = row + 1
		end
	end
	local out: { string } = {}
	for row = 1, lastNonEmpty do
		out[#out + 1] = rows[row]
	end
	return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

return Machine

--!strict
-- A keyframe clip as a curve clip: keys through every pose, with smooth tangents.

local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local currentBackend = Store.currentBackend
local markerCurve = Store.markerCurve
local nearestAngles = Write.nearestAngles
local smoothChannel = Write.smoothChannel

type Key = Store.Key
type Marker = Store.Marker

local Convert = {}

-- A curve clip that passes through every pose of a keyframe clip, with smooth tangents.
-- Between keys the motion follows the curves, not Roblox's per-stretch easing, so it can
-- differ there; at the keys it is the same.
function Convert.fromKeyframes(
	sequence: Instance,
	keyframes: { Keyframe },
	findPose: (Keyframe, string) -> Pose?
): Instance
	local clip = Roblox.Instance.new("CurveAnimation")
	clip.Name = sequence.Name;
	(clip :: any).Loop = (sequence :: any).Loop;
	(clip :: any).Priority = (sequence :: any).Priority
	for _, joint in Rig.R15_ORDER do
		local samples: { { time: number, values: { number } } } = {}
		for _, keyframe in keyframes do
			local pose = findPose(keyframe, joint)
			if pose and pose.Weight > 0 then
				local position = pose.CFrame.Position
				local x, y, z = pose.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				local values = { position.X, position.Y, position.Z, x, y, z }
				local before = samples[#samples]
				if before then
					-- The angles nearest the key before, so the curve takes the short way.
					local chosen = nearestAngles(x, y, z, { before.values[4], before.values[5], before.values[6] })
					values[4], values[5], values[6] = chosen[1], chosen[2], chosen[3]
				end
				table.insert(samples, { time = keyframe.Time, values = values })
			end
		end
		if #samples == 0 then
			continue
		end
		for index, channel in { "position.x", "position.y", "position.z", "rotation.x", "rotation.y", "rotation.z" } do
			local moves = false
			for _, sample in samples do
				moves = moves or math.abs(sample.values[index]) > 1e-6
			end
			if moves then
				local keys: { Key } = {}
				for _, sample in samples do
					table.insert(keys, {
						time = sample.time,
						value = sample.values[index],
						interpolation = "Cubic",
						left = 0,
						right = 0,
					})
				end
				local curve = Store.channel(clip, joint, channel, true) :: Instance
				Store.setKeys(curve, keys)
				smoothChannel(curve, 0, math.huge, {}, (sequence :: any).Loop == true)
			end
		end
	end
	local markers: { [string]: { Marker } } = {}
	for _, keyframe in keyframes do
		for _, child: any in keyframe:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("KeyframeMarker") then
				markers[child.Name] = markers[child.Name] or {}
				table.insert(markers[child.Name], { time = keyframe.Time, value = child.Value })
			end
		end
	end
	for name, list in markers do
		currentBackend().setMarkers(markerCurve(clip, name, true) :: Instance, list)
	end
	return clip
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reading

return Convert
