--!strict
-- Memory.lua -- 32-bit physical memory for a 486/Pentium-class PC.
--
-- The RAM buffer is a flat byte array (16/32/64 MiB by default), but the first
-- megabyte follows the PC memory map:
--
--   00000-9FFFF  conventional RAM
--   A0000-AFFFF  VGA graphics aperture (routed to the VGA device)
--   B0000-B7FFF  monochrome text (unused on VGA)
--   B8000-BFFFF  colour text aperture (plain RAM; VGA text reads B8000)
--   C0000-DFFFF  option ROM / expansion space (open bus when a BIOS is present)
--   E0000-FFFFF  BIOS ROM (256 KiB SeaBIOS image; reset vector at FFFF0)
--
-- With no ROM installed the E0000-FFFFF window stays backed by RAM so the old
-- legacy hypervisor stubs (IVT trampolines at F000:0100, XMS entry at F100:00C0)
-- keep working. Once loadRom() is called, ROM reads are served from the image
-- and writes to ROM are ignored.
--
-- A20M is applied before the memory map: while the gate is closed address bit
-- 20 is forced low, so the 1-2 MiB range folds onto 0-1 MiB. Higher address
-- bits are not folded (0x200000 stays 0x200000), which is what a real 486
-- chipset does.
--
-- There is no wrap at the top of RAM. Addresses outside RAM/ROM/aperture are
-- open bus: reads return 0xFF and writes are dropped.

const band, bor, bnot, lshift, rshift =
	bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Memory = {}
Memory.__index = Memory

Memory.SIZE = 16 * 1024 * 1024
Memory.ROM_BASE = 0xE0000
Memory.ROM_SIZE = 0x40000
Memory.ROM_ALIAS = 0xF0000 -- legacy entry point inside the 256 KiB image
const A20_BIT = 0x100000
const APERTURE_START = 0xA0000
const APERTURE_END = 0xAFFFF
const VBE_LFB_START = 0xE0000000
const VBE_LFB_END = 0xE0400000
const TEXT_START = 0xB0000
const TEXT_END = 0xBFFFF
const ONE_MIB = 0x100000

export type Aperture = {
	read8: (self: any, addr: number) -> number,
	write8: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
	read16: (self: any, addr: number) -> number,
	write16: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
}

export type Memory = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		buf: buffer,
		size: number,
		mask: number,
		a20: boolean,
		protectStart: number?,
		protectEnd: number?,
		aperture: Aperture?,
		rom: buffer?,
		romBase: number,
		romSize: number,
		romLowOffset: number,
		romHighBase: number,
		romShadowed: boolean,
		lowRomLockMask: number,
	},
	Memory
))

function Memory.new(size: number?): Memory
	const bytes = size or Memory.SIZE
	if bytes < 1024 or band(bytes, bytes - 1) ~= 0 then
		error(("memory size must be a power of two >= 1024 (got %d)"):format(bytes))
	end
	if bytes > 0x100000000 then
		error(("memory size must fit the 32-bit physical bus (got %d)"):format(bytes))
	end
	return setmetatable({
		buf = buffer.create(bytes),
		size = bytes,
		mask = bytes - 1,
		a20 = false,
		rom = nil,
		romBase = Memory.ROM_BASE,
		romSize = 0,
		romLowOffset = 0,
		romHighBase = 0,
		romShadowed = false,
		lowRomLockMask = 0,
	}, Memory)
end

-- Load a BIOS image. QEMU/SeaBIOS's 256 KiB build is linked for the top of the
-- 32-bit address space (0xFFFC0000-0xFFFFFFFF) and its last 128 KiB are
-- mirrored at E0000-FFFFF for the legacy reset/BIOS window. The reset vector's
-- far jump to F000:E05B therefore lands in the low mirror while the main body
-- can also be fetched through the high mapping by 32-bit code.
function Memory:loadRom(image: buffer, base: number?)
	const length = buffer.len(image)
	if length == 0 or length > Memory.ROM_SIZE then
		error(("BIOS image must be 1..%d bytes (got %d)"):format(Memory.ROM_SIZE, length))
	end
	const start = base or Memory.ROM_BASE
	if start < Memory.ROM_BASE or start + math.min(length, 0x20000) > 0x100000 then
		error(("BIOS low window %d bytes does not fit E0000-FFFFF (base %X)"):format(length, start))
	end
	self.rom = image
	self.romBase = start
	self.romSize = length
	-- The legacy window is the last 128 KiB of the image, placed linearly at
	-- E0000. For a 256 KiB image that is offset 0x20000.
	self.romLowOffset = math.max(0, length - 0x20000)
	self.romHighBase = 0x100000000 - length
	-- Real chipsets shadow the BIOS into RAM before POST finishes. SeaBIOS's
	-- 32-bit flat code/BSS and F-segment allocator live in E0000-FFFFF, so the
	-- legacy alias is a writable copy of the image's last 128 KiB. The 256 KiB
	-- high mapping at 0xFFFC0000 remains the read-only ROM.
	if self.size >= 0x100000 then
		const shadowLength = math.min(length, 0x20000)
		buffer.copy(self.buf, 0xE0000, image, length - shadowLength, shadowLength)
		self.romShadowed = true
	end
	return start
end

function Memory:hasRom(): boolean
	return self.rom ~= nil
end

-- SeaBIOS locks the legacy BIOS shadow through the i440FX PAM registers just
-- before boot. The F-segment holds the running firmware and must become
-- read-only. E0000-EFFFF is BIOS extension RAM, and SeaBIOS keeps its
-- real-mode IRQ stack there (SS=DA80, SP=F9xx lands at EA1EC), so it must stay
-- writable after the lock.
-- The i440FX PAM registers protect individual 32 KiB chunks of
-- C0000-FFFFF. The VGA option ROM uses E8000-EFFFF as a writable stack even
-- after the BIOS locks its own F-segment, so this must be a bitmask, not one
-- global boolean.
function Memory:setLowRomLockMask(mask: number)
	self.lowRomLockMask = band(mask, 0xFF)
end

function Memory:lockLowRom(locked: boolean)
	self.lowRomLockMask = if locked then 0xC0 else 0
end

function Memory:isLowRomLocked(addr: number): boolean
	if self.lowRomLockMask == 0 or addr < 0xC0000 or addr > 0xFFFFF then
		return false
	end
	const chunk = band(rshift(addr - 0xC0000, 15), 7)
	return band(self.lowRomLockMask, lshift(1, chunk)) ~= 0
end

function Memory:hasLockedLowRom(addr: number, length: number): boolean
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		if self:isLowRomLocked(addr + index) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Option ROMs are shadowed into the C0000-DFFFF expansion window. The window
-- is already plain RAM, so a copy is enough for SeaBIOS's option-ROM scanner.
function Memory:loadOptionRom(image: buffer, base: number?)
	const length = buffer.len(image)
	const start = base or 0xC0000
	if length == 0 or start < 0xC0000 or start + length > 0xE0000 then
		error(("option ROM %d bytes does not fit C0000-DFFFF (base %X)"):format(length, start))
	end
	if self.size < start + length then
		error("option ROM exceeds configured RAM")
	end
	buffer.copy(self.buf, start, image, 0, length)
	return start
end

-- Physical translation: A20M first, then the 32-bit bus. No wrap at RAM size.
function Memory:translate(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bit32.bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	return addr
end

-- A20 is exposed both as a plain field (mem.a20 = true, used by XMS) and as a
-- gate helper so chipset code can share the port-0x92 path.
function Memory:setA20(on: boolean)
	self.a20 = on
end

function Memory:isProtected(addr: number): boolean
	const start = self.protectStart
	const stop = self.protectEnd
	return start ~= nil and stop ~= nil and addr >= start and addr <= stop
end

-- True when [addr, addr+length) is plain RAM with no aperture or ROM shadow.
function Memory:isRam(addr: number, length: number): boolean
	if length <= 0 or addr + length > self.size then
		return false
	end
	const last = addr + length - 1
	if addr < APERTURE_START then
		return last < APERTURE_START
	elseif addr < ONE_MIB then
		if addr >= TEXT_START and addr <= TEXT_END then
			return last <= TEXT_END
		end
		-- C0000-DFFFF is option-ROM/shadow RAM. SeaBIOS copies its 32-bit
		-- decompression stub there before switching to flat protected mode.
		if addr >= 0xC0000 and last <= 0xDFFFF then
			return true
		end
		if self.romShadowed and addr >= 0xE0000 and last <= 0xFFFFF then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function Memory:read8(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	-- Hot path: plain conventional/RAM, away from the VGA aperture, option-ROM
	-- shadow and BIOS windows. isProtected is only ever configured by host
	-- tooling, never by the guest, so a nil check preserves the slow path.
	if self.protectStart == nil then
		if
			(addr < APERTURE_START and addr < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and addr < self.size)
		then
			return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
		end
	end
	const rom = self.rom
	if rom then
		if addr >= self.romHighBase then
			const offset = addr - self.romHighBase
			if offset < self.romSize then
				return buffer.readu8(rom, offset)
			end
		end
		const romBase: number = self.romBase
		if addr >= romBase and addr <= 0xFFFFF then
			const shadowed = self.romShadowed and addr >= 0xE0000
			if not shadowed then
				const lowBase: number = self.romLowOffset
				const lowOffset: number = lowBase + addr - romBase
				if lowOffset < self.romSize then
					return buffer.readu8(rom, lowOffset)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 1) then
		return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read8(addr)
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read8(addr)
	end
	-- No ROM installed: preserve the legacy hypervisor's writable high segment.
	if not rom and addr >= Memory.ROM_BASE and addr <= 0xFFFFF and addr < self.size then
		return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Memory:read16(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 1
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		return buffer.readu16(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 2) then
		return buffer.readu16(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr + 1 <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read16(addr)
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr + 1 < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read16(addr)
	end
	return bor(self:read8(addr), lshift(self:read8(addr + 1), 8))
end

function Memory:read32(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 3
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		return buffer.readu32(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 4) then
		return buffer.readu32(self.buf, addr)
	end
	return bor(self:read16(addr), lshift(self:read16(addr + 2), 16))
end

function Memory:write8(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((addr < APERTURE_START and addr < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and addr < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:isLowRomLocked(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 1) then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write8(addr, value)
		return
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write8(addr, value)
		return
	end
	-- No ROM installed: keep the hypervisor stub window writable.
	if not self.rom and addr >= Memory.ROM_BASE and addr <= 0xFFFFF and addr < self.size then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
	end
	-- ROM, option ROM and open bus are read-only.
end

function Memory:write16(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 1
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu16(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:hasLockedLowRom(addr, 2) then
		self:write8(addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		self:write8(addr + 1, band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 2) then
		buffer.writeu16(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
		return
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr + 1 <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write16(addr, value)
		return
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr + 1 < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write16(addr, value)
		return
	end
	self:write8(addr, value)
	self:write8(addr + 1, rshift(value, 8))
end

function Memory:write32(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 3
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu32(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:hasLockedLowRom(addr, 4) then
		for index = 0, 3 do
			self:write8(addr + index, band(rshift(value, index * 8), 0xFF))
		end
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 4) then
		buffer.writeu32(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		return
	end
	self:write16(addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
	self:write16(addr + 2, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
end

-- Copy a Luau buffer into memory at a physical address. This bypasses MMIO but
-- still respects ROM shadows and memory bounds.
function Memory:copyFrom(addr: number, src: buffer)
	const length = buffer.len(src)
	addr = self:translate(addr)
	if self:isRam(addr, length) and not self:isProtected(addr) then
		buffer.copy(self.buf, addr, src, 0, length)
		return
	end
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		self:write8(addr + index, buffer.readu8(src, index))
	end
end

-- Copy a region of memory out as a new buffer.
function Memory:copyTo(addr: number, length: number): buffer
	local out = buffer.create(length)
	addr = self:translate(addr)
	if self:isRam(addr, length) then
		buffer.copy(out, 0, self.buf, addr, length)
		return out
	end
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		buffer.writeu8(out, index, self:read8(addr + index))
	end
	return out
end

function Memory:writeString(addr: number, str: string)
	const base: number = self:translate(addr)
	for index = 1, #str do
		const byte = string.byte(str, index) :: number
		self:write8(base + index - 1, byte)
	end
end

function Memory:readString(addr: number, length: number): string
	const base: number = self:translate(addr)
	local parts: { string } = {}
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		const byte: number = self:read8(base + index)
		parts[index + 1] = string.char(byte)
	end
	return table.concat(parts)
end

-- 8086-style segment:offset helper (20-bit wrap). 386 code should use the
-- CPU's segment caches instead; this remains for legacy callers and tests.
function Memory.phys(seg: number, off: number): number
	return band(lshift(seg, 4) + off, 0xFFFFF)
end

return Memory

--!strict
-- Putting the body on the floor, and keeping a hand or foot off it.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Body = require("./Body")
local Limb = require("../../Rigs/Limb")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Pose = require("../../Rigs/Pose")
local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local count = Frames.count
local FLOORED = Body.FLOORED
local floorOf = Body.floorOf
local FRAME_SLACK = Frames.FRAME_SLACK
local hasGeometry = Body.hasGeometry
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local milliseconds = Need.milliseconds
local needBlends = Need.needBlends
local needJoint = Need.needJoint
local needJoints = Need.needJoints
local needOneOf = Need.needOneOf
local needRange = Need.needRange
local readChannels = Frames.readChannels
local refuse = Need.refuse
local rounded = Need.rounded
local smoothstep = Frames.smoothstep
local spanOf = Frames.spanOf
local transformsAt = Frames.transformsAt
local writeFrames = Write.writeFrames
local writeTurns = Write.writeTurns

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context

local Ops = {}

Ops.place_on_floor = {
	-- Its range may run across a looping clip's end (see Seam).
	wraps = true,

	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needRange(where, operation, true)
		if operation.mode ~= nil then
			needOneOf(where, operation.mode, "mode", Store.FLOOR_MODES)
		end
		needJoints(where, operation.parts, joints)
		needBlends(where, operation)
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local joints = context.joints
		if not hasGeometry(joints, Rig.R15_ORDER) then
			refuse(where, "this rig's parts could not be measured, so the floor cannot be found.")
		end
		local duration = Store.duration(clip)
		if operation.time_to > duration + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
			refuse(
				where,
				`the clip ends at {milliseconds(duration)} seconds, before time_to.`,
				"Key the clip out to its full length first."
			)
		end
		local from, to = operation.time_from, operation.time_to
		local first = math.max(0, from - (operation.blend_in or 0))
		local last = math.min(duration, to + (operation.blend_out or 0))
		local rate = Store.FRAME_RATE
		local firstFrame = math.ceil(first * rate - FRAME_SLACK)
		local lastFrame = math.floor(last * rate + FRAME_SLACK)
		if lastFrame < firstFrame then
			refuse(where, "the range holds no whole frame; Studio shows a curve clip only at whole frames.")
		end
		local touch = operation.mode == "touch"
		local parts = operation.parts or FLOORED
		local floor = floorOf(joints)
		local channels = readChannels(clip)
		local scan = { joints = joints } :: any
		local identity = Roblox.CFrame.new()
		-- The hips' position is measured in the root joint's own frame; straight up in the
		-- rig is this direction there.
		local c0 = Rig.rest(joints.LowerTorso)
		local up = c0:VectorToObjectSpace(Roblox.Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

		local moves: { number } = {}
		local raised, lowered, moved = 0, 0, 0
		for frame = firstFrame, lastFrame do
			local time = frame / rate
			local lowest = math.huge
			for _, part in Pose.track(scan, transformsAt(channels, time), identity, parts) do
				lowest = math.min(lowest, part.lowest)
			end
			local move = floor - lowest
			if not touch then
				move = math.max(0, move)
			end
			if time < from - Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				move *= smoothstep((time - first) / math.max(from - first, 1e-6))
			elseif time > to + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				move *= smoothstep((last - time) / math.max(last - to, 1e-6))
			end
			if math.abs(move) > 0.001 then
				moved += 1
			end
			raised = math.max(raised, move)
			lowered = math.max(lowered, -move)
			table.insert(moves, move)
		end
		count(changed, "frames_moved", moved)
		if moved == 0 then
			return
		end
		changed.largest_raise_studs = math.max(changed.largest_raise_studs or 0, rounded(raised, 3))
		if lowered > 0 then
			changed.largest_drop_studs = math.max(changed.largest_drop_studs or 0, rounded(lowered, 3))
		end
		local own = channels.LowerTorso or {}
		for axis, letter in { "x", "y", "z" } do
			local share = ({ up.X, up.Y, up.Z })[axis]
			if math.abs(share) < 1e-9 then
				continue
			end
			local channel = `position.{letter}`
			local original = own[channel] or {}
			local values = {}
			for index, move in moves do
				values[index] = Store.evaluate(original, (firstFrame + index - 1) / rate) + move * share
			end
			writeFrames(clip, "LowerTorso", channel, original, {
				first = firstFrame,
				last = lastFrame,
				values = values,
				duration = duration,
			}, changed)
		end
	end,
}

Ops.clear_floor = {
	-- Its range may run across a looping clip's end (see Seam).
	wraps = true,

	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		local chain = if type(operation.part) == "string" then Limb.CHAINS[operation.part] else nil
		if not chain then
			refuse(where, "part must be LeftFoot, RightFoot, LeftHand or RightHand.")
		end
		for _, name in chain :: { string } do
			needJoint(where, name, joints)
		end
		needRange(where, operation, true)
		local clearance = operation.clearance
		if clearance ~= nil and (not isFinite(clearance) or clearance < 0 or clearance > 2) then
			refuse(where, "clearance must be from 0 to 2 studs.")
		end
		needBlends(where, operation)
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local joints = context.joints
		if not hasGeometry(joints, Rig.R15_ORDER) then
			refuse(where, "this rig's parts could not be measured, so the floor cannot be found.")
		end
		local span = spanOf(where, clip, operation)
		local chain = Limb.CHAINS[operation.part]
		local limb = { joints[chain[1]], joints[chain[2]], joints[chain[3]] }
		local channels = readChannels(clip)
		local scan = { joints = joints } :: any
		local identity = Roblox.CFrame.new()
		local lowestAllowed = floorOf(joints) + (operation.clearance or 0.05)
		local rate = Store.FRAME_RATE
		local turns: { [string]: { CFrame } } = { [chain[1]] = {}, [chain[2]] = {}, [chain[3]] = {} }
		local lifted, highest, missed = 0, 0, 0
		for frame = span.first, span.last do
			local index = frame - span.first + 1
			local time = frame / rate
			local transforms = transformsAt(channels, time)
			local placed = Pose.place(scan, transforms, identity)
			local current = { transforms[chain[1]], transforms[chain[2]], transforms[chain[3]] }
			local lowest = Pose.track(scan, transforms, identity, { chain[3] })[chain[3]].lowest
			-- How far short of the clearance it is, eased over the blends.
			local short = (lowestAllowed - lowest) * span.weight(time)
			local result = current
			if short > 0.0005 then
				-- Straight up by that much, turned as it is.
				local tip = Roblox.CFrame.new(0, short, 0) * placed[chain[3]]
				local solution = Limb.solve({
					parent = placed[Rig.R15_PARENTS[chain[1]]],
					joints = limb,
					current = current,
					pivot = Limb.pivotOf(limb[3], tip),
					tip = tip,
					bend = Limb.BEND[operation.part],
				})
				result = solution.transforms
				lifted += 1
				highest = math.max(highest, short)
				if solution.beyond then
					missed += 1
				end
			end
			for position, joint in chain do
				turns[joint][index] = result[position]
			end
		end
		count(changed, "frames_lifted", lifted)
		if lifted == 0 then
			return
		end
		for _, joint in chain do
			writeTurns(
				clip,
				joint,
				channels[joint] or {},
				span.first,
				span.last,
				turns[joint],
				Store.duration(clip),
				changed,
				true
			)
		end
		changed.largest_lift_studs = math.max(changed.largest_lift_studs or 0, rounded(highest, 3))
		if missed > 0 then
			count(changed, "frames_out_of_reach", missed)
		end
	end,
}

return Ops

--!strict
-- Ne2000.lua -- DP8390-compatible NE2000 Ethernet controller.
--
-- The guest sees the classic 16-bit ISA card at 0x300/IRQ10: 16 register
-- bytes, a remote-DMA data port, a reset port, and 32 KiB of packet memory
-- (the top 16 KiB is the receive/transmit ring). The host injects and receives
-- Ethernet frames through callbacks, so the core stays environment-pure.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Ne2000 = {}
Ne2000.__index = Ne2000

Ne2000.BASE = 0x300
Ne2000.IRQ = 10
Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET = 0x10
Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET = 0x1F
Ne2000.MEM_SIZE = 0x8000
Ne2000.PMEM_START = 0x4000
Ne2000.MAX_FRAME = 1514

-- Page-0 command bits.
const CR_STOP = 0x01
const CR_TXP = 0x04
const CR_RREAD = 0x08
const CR_RWRITE = 0x10
const CR_NODMA = 0x20
const CR_PAGE1 = 0x40
const CR_PAGE2 = 0x80

const ISR_RX = 0x01
const ISR_TX = 0x02
const ISR_TX_ERR = 0x08
const ISR_OVER = 0x10
const ISR_RDC = 0x40
const ISR_RESET = 0x80

const TSR_PTX = 0x01

export type Config = {
	mac: string?,
	base: number?,
	irq: number?,
	transmit: ((frame: buffer) -> ())?,
}

export type Ne2000 = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		base: number,
		irq: number,
		mem: buffer,
		cmd: number,
		start: number,
		stop: number,
		boundary: number,
		curpag: number,
		tsr: number,
		tpsr: number,
		tcnt: number,
		rsar: number,
		rcnt: number,
		rsr: number,
		rxcr: number,
		isr: number,
		dcfg: number,
		imr: number,
		phys: { number },
		mult: { number },
		transmit: ((frame: buffer) -> ())?,
		irqLine: boolean,
		new: (config: Config?) -> Ne2000,
		reset: (self: Ne2000) -> (),
		in8: (self: Ne2000, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		in16: (self: Ne2000, port: number) -> number,
		out16: (self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		irqPending: (self: Ne2000) -> boolean,
		takeIrq: (self: Ne2000) -> boolean,
		receive: (self: Ne2000, frame: buffer) -> boolean,
		macString: (self: Ne2000) -> string,
	},
	Ne2000
))

local function parseMac(text: string?): { number }
	const source = text or "52:54:00:12:34:56"
	const out = { 0x52, 0x54, 0, 0x12, 0x34, 0x56 }
	local index = 0
	for part in string.gmatch(source, "[^:%-]+") do
		if index < 6 then
			out[index + 1] = band(tonumber(part, 16) or 0, 0xFF)
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function macText(phys: { number }): string
	return string.format(
		"%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
		phys[1],
		phys[2],
		phys[3],
		phys[4],
		phys[5],
		phys[6]
	)
end

function Ne2000.new(config: Config?): Ne2000
	const cfg: Config = config or {}
	local self = setmetatable({}, Ne2000) :: any
	self.base = cfg.base or Ne2000.BASE
	self.irq = cfg.irq or Ne2000.IRQ
	self.mem = buffer.create(Ne2000.MEM_SIZE)
	self.phys = parseMac(cfg.mac)
	self.mult = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.transmit = cfg.transmit
	self.irqLine = false
	self:reset()
	return self
end

function Ne2000.reset(self: Ne2000)
	self.cmd = bor(CR_STOP, CR_NODMA)
	self.start = 0x46 * 256
	self.stop = 0x80 * 256
	self.boundary = 0x46
	self.curpag = 0x46
	self.tsr = 0
	self.tpsr = 0
	self.tcnt = 0
	self.rsar = 0
	self.rcnt = 0
	self.rsr = 0
	self.rxcr = 0
	self.dcfg = 0
	self.imr = 0
	self.isr = ISR_RESET
	buffer.fill(self.mem, 0, Ne2000.MEM_SIZE, 0)
	for index = 1, 6 do
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, index - 1, self.phys[index])
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (index - 1) * 2, self.phys[index])
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (index - 1) * 2 + 1, self.phys[index])
	end
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, 14, 0x57)
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, 15, 0x57)
	self.irqLine = false
end

function Ne2000.macString(self: Ne2000): string
	return macText(self.phys)
end

local function updateIrq(self: Ne2000)
	-- irqLine is the edge/latched state consumed by Machine.takeIrq. A new
	-- pending bit does not set it; takeIrq raises it once, and clearing ISR
	-- through the mask arms it for the next interrupt.
	if band(self.isr, self.imr) == 0 then
		self.irqLine = false
	end
end

function Ne2000.irqPending(self: Ne2000): boolean
	return band(self.isr, self.imr) ~= 0
end

-- One-shot line read for a machine that raises IRQ10 on a rising edge.
function Ne2000.takeIrq(self: Ne2000): boolean
	if not self:irqPending() then
		self.irqLine = false
		return false
	end
	if self.irqLine then
		return false
	end
	self.irqLine = true
	return true
end

local function page(self: Ne2000): number
	return band(self.cmd, 0xC0)
end

local function localIndex(pageNumber: number): number
	return band(pageNumber, 0x7F) * 256
end

local function ringNext(self: Ne2000, pageNumber: number): number
	local nextPage = pageNumber + 1
	if nextPage >= rshift(self.stop, 8) then
		nextPage = rshift(self.start, 8)
	end
	return nextPage
end

local function transmitPacket(self: Ne2000)
	const index = localIndex(self.tpsr)
	if self.tcnt == 0 or self.tcnt > Ne2000.MAX_FRAME then
		self.tsr = 0x20 -- FIFO underrun
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_TX_ERR)
		updateIrq(self)
		return
	end
	local frame = buffer.create(self.tcnt)
	buffer.copy(frame, 0, self.mem, index, self.tcnt)
	self.tsr = TSR_PTX
	self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_TX)
	self.cmd = band(self.cmd, bit32.bnot(CR_TXP))
	if self.transmit then
		self.transmit(frame)
	end
	updateIrq(self)
end

function Ne2000.receive(self: Ne2000, frame: buffer): boolean
	const length = buffer.len(frame)
	if length < 14 or length > Ne2000.MAX_FRAME then
		return false
	end
	local target = self.curpag
	local address = localIndex(target)
	local nextPage = ringNext(self, target)
	while true do
		const needed = 4 + length
		const room = if nextPage > target
			then localIndex(nextPage) - address
			else self.stop - address + self.start - localIndex(rshift(self.start, 8))
		if needed + 4 <= room then
			break
		end
		target = nextPage
		address = localIndex(target)
		nextPage = ringNext(self, target)
		if target == self.curpag then
			self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_OVER)
			updateIrq(self)
			return false
		end
	end
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, address, ISR_RX)
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, address + 1, nextPage)
	buffer.writeu16(self.mem, address + 2, length)
	buffer.copy(self.mem, address + 4, frame, 0, length)
	self.curpag = nextPage
	self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RX)
	updateIrq(self)
	return true
end

local function dmaReadByte(self: Ne2000): number
	if band(self.cmd, CR_RREAD) == 0 or self.rcnt == 0 then
		return 0xFF
	end
	local value = 0xFF
	if self.rsar >= Ne2000.PMEM_START and self.rsar < Ne2000.MEM_SIZE then
		value = buffer.readu8(self.mem, self.rsar)
	end
	self.rsar = band(self.rsar + 1, 0xFFFF)
	self.rcnt = if self.rcnt > 0 then self.rcnt - 1 else 0
	if self.rcnt == 0 then
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RDC)
		updateIrq(self)
	end
	return value
end

local function dmaWriteByte(self: Ne2000, value: number)
	if band(self.cmd, CR_RWRITE) == 0 or self.rcnt == 0 then
		return
	end
	if self.rsar >= Ne2000.PMEM_START and self.rsar < Ne2000.MEM_SIZE then
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, self.rsar, band(value, 0xFF))
	end
	self.rsar = band(self.rsar + 1, 0xFFFF)
	self.rcnt = if self.rcnt > 0 then self.rcnt - 1 else 0
	if self.rcnt == 0 then
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RDC)
		updateIrq(self)
	end
end

local function readRegister(self: Ne2000, offset: number): number
	const current = page(self)
	if offset == 0 then
		return self.cmd
	end
	if current == 0 then
		if offset == 1 then
			return band(self.rsar, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 2 then
			return band(rshift(self.rsar, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 3 then
			return self.boundary
		elseif offset == 4 then
			return self.tsr
		elseif offset == 5 then
			return 0
		elseif offset == 6 then
			return 0
		elseif offset == 7 then
			return self.isr
		elseif offset == 8 then
			return band(self.rsar, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 9 then
			return band(rshift(self.rsar, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 10 then
			return band(self.rcnt, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 11 then
			return band(rshift(self.rcnt, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 12 then
			return self.rsr
		elseif offset == 13 or offset == 14 or offset == 15 then
			return 0
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE1 then
		if offset >= 1 and offset <= 6 then
			return self.phys[offset]
		elseif offset == 7 then
			return self.curpag
		elseif offset >= 8 and offset <= 15 then
			return self.mult[offset - 7]
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE2 then
		if offset == 1 then
			return band(rshift(self.start, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 2 then
			return band(rshift(self.stop, 8), 0xFF)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function writeRegister(self: Ne2000, offset: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		self.cmd = value
		if band(value, CR_STOP) ~= 0 then
			-- Stop/reset the chip without clearing the packet RAM.
			self.tsr = 0
		end
		if band(value, CR_TXP) ~= 0 then
			transmitPacket(self)
		end
		return
	end
	const current = page(self)
	if current == 0 then
		if offset == 1 then
			self.start = value * 256
		elseif offset == 2 then
			self.stop = value * 256
		elseif offset == 3 then
			self.boundary = value
		elseif offset == 4 then
			self.tpsr = value
		elseif offset == 5 then
			self.tcnt = bor(band(self.tcnt, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 6 then
			self.tcnt = bor(band(self.tcnt, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 7 then
			self.isr = band(self.isr, bit32.bnot(value))
			updateIrq(self)
		elseif offset == 8 then
			self.rsar = bor(band(self.rsar, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 9 then
			self.rsar = bor(band(self.rsar, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 10 then
			self.rcnt = bor(band(self.rcnt, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 11 then
			self.rcnt = bor(band(self.rcnt, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 12 then
			self.rxcr = value
		elseif offset == 13 then
			-- transmit configuration: loopback is not modelled
		elseif offset == 14 then
			self.dcfg = value
		elseif offset == 15 then
			self.imr = value
			updateIrq(self)
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE1 then
		if offset >= 1 and offset <= 6 then
			self.phys[offset] = value
			buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (offset - 1) * 2, value)
			buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (offset - 1) * 2 + 1, value)
		elseif offset == 7 then
			self.curpag = value
		elseif offset >= 8 and offset <= 15 then
			self.mult[offset - 7] = value
		end
	end
end

function Ne2000.in8(self: Ne2000, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		return dmaReadByte(self)
	elseif offset == Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET then
		return 0
	elseif offset < Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		return readRegister(self, offset)
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Ne2000.out8(self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number)
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		dmaWriteByte(self, value)
	elseif offset == Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET then
		self:reset()
	elseif offset < Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		writeRegister(self, offset, value)
	end
end

function Ne2000.in16(self: Ne2000, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		if band(self.dcfg, 0x01) == 0 then
			return self:in8(port)
		end
		const low = dmaReadByte(self)
		const high = dmaReadByte(self)
		return bor(low, lshift(high, 8))
	end
	return self:in8(port)
end

function Ne2000.out16(self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number)
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET and band(self.dcfg, 0x01) ~= 0 then
		dmaWriteByte(self, band(value, 0xFF))
		dmaWriteByte(self, band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		return
	end
	self:out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
end

return Ne2000

--!strict
-- A curve clip at whole frames, as the operations that work frame by frame read it: the
-- channels read once, the pose at a time, ranges and their blends; and what an operation
-- is given and reports.

local Need = require("./Need")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")
local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Store = require("./Store")

local milliseconds = Need.milliseconds
local refuse = Need.refuse

type Key = Store.Key

local Frames = {}

-- `clips`: other curve clips of the same rig an operation may read from, by the name the
-- operation gives them (copy_pose's from_clip).
export type Context = { joints: { [string]: any }, source: Instance?, clips: { [string]: Instance }? }

export type Changed = { [string]: number }

local function count(changed: Changed, what: string, by: number?)
	changed[what] = (changed[what] or 0) + (by or 1)
end

local function near(a: number, b: number): boolean
	return math.abs(a - b) < Store.TIME_TOLERANCE
end

-- The keys of every channel of a clip, read once, by joint and then by channel.
export type Channels = { [string]: { [string]: { Key } } }

local function readChannels(clip: Instance): Channels
	local channels: Channels = {}
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		channels[track.joint] = channels[track.joint] or {}
		channels[track.joint][track.channel] = Store.keys(track.curve)
	end
	return channels
end

-- The transform of every joint of the rig at a time, as the channels give it.
local function transformsAt(channels: Channels, time: number): { [string]: CFrame }
	local transforms: { [string]: CFrame } = {}
	for _, joint in Rig.R15_ORDER do
		local values = {}
		local own = channels[joint]
		for index, channel in Store.CHANNELS do
			local keys = own and own[channel]
			values[index] = if keys then Store.evaluate(keys, time) else 0
		end
		transforms[joint] = Roblox.CFrame.new(values[1], values[2], values[3])
			* Roblox.CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(values[4], values[5], values[6])
	end
	return transforms
end

-- How far from a whole frame, in frames, a time may be and still count as that frame: a
-- millisecond, as for keys. A time written as 1.1333 is frame 34 (1.13333...).
local FRAME_SLACK = Store.TIME_TOLERANCE * Store.FRAME_RATE

-- Rounds a smooth step from 0 to 1 as `t` goes from 0 to 1.
local function smoothstep(t: number): number
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

-- The whole frames an operation with a range and blends covers, and how much of it applies
-- at a time: 1 inside the range, easing from 0 over the blends.
export type Span = { first: number, last: number, weight: (time: number) -> number }

local function spanOf(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any): Span
	local duration = Store.duration(clip)
	if operation.time_to > duration + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
		refuse(
			where,
			`the clip ends at {milliseconds(duration)} seconds, before time_to.`,
			"Key the clip out to its full length first."
		)
	end
	local from, to = operation.time_from, operation.time_to
	local first = math.max(0, from - (operation.blend_in or 0))
	local last = math.min(duration, to + (operation.blend_out or 0))
	local rate = Store.FRAME_RATE
	local firstFrame = math.ceil(first * rate - FRAME_SLACK)
	local lastFrame = math.floor(last * rate + FRAME_SLACK)
	if lastFrame < firstFrame then
		refuse(where, "the range holds no whole frame; Studio shows a curve clip only at whole frames.")
	end
	return {
		first = firstFrame,
		last = lastFrame,
		weight = function(time: number): number
			if time < from - Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				return smoothstep((time - first) / math.max(from - first, 1e-6))
			elseif time > to + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				return smoothstep((last - time) / math.max(last - to, 1e-6))
			end
			return 1
		end,
	}
end

Frames.count = count
Frames.near = near
Frames.readChannels = readChannels
Frames.transformsAt = transformsAt
Frames.FRAME_SLACK = FRAME_SLACK
Frames.smoothstep = smoothstep
Frames.spanOf = spanOf

return Frames

-- Sound's methods, events and property rules: where Play starts, what
-- Stop, Pause and Resume do in each state, ends, loops and seeks.
local s = Instance.new("Sound")
s.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/action_falling.ogg" -- 10 s
-- Whether Loaded comes before or after a Play right after parenting
-- depends on Studio's cache, so it's only checked to have fired.
local loaded
s.Loaded:Connect(function(id)
    loaded = id
end)
local function near(x, target)
    return math.abs(x - target) < 0.12
end
local function state(tag)
    log(tag, s.Playing, s.IsPlaying, s.IsPaused)
end

s.Parent = workspace
for _ = 1, 100 do
    if s.IsLoaded then
        break
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
end
log("Loaded fired with", loaded)
for _, name in { "Played", "Paused", "Resumed", "Stopped", "Ended", "Loaded", "DidLoop" } do
    s[name]:Connect(function(...)
        log("event", name, ...)
    end)
end
state("before Play")
s:Play()
state("played")
task.wait(0.5)
log("time advances", near(s.TimePosition, 0.5))

-- Play while playing restarts, without Played.
s:Play()
log("restart", near(s.TimePosition, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

-- Pause keeps the place; Pause again and Stop on a paused sound do nothing.
s:Pause()
local paused = s.TimePosition
state("paused")
s:Pause()
s:Stop()
log("stop while paused keeps place", s.TimePosition == paused)
s:Resume()
log("resume from place", near(s.TimePosition, paused))
s:Resume()

-- Play starts where a script last set TimePosition, even after Pause.
s.TimePosition = 3
task.wait(0.3)
s:Pause()
s:Play()
log("play from last set", near(s.TimePosition, 3))
s:Stop()
state("stopped")
log("stop rewinds", s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
log("play after stop", near(s.TimePosition, 0))

-- Setting Playing directly fires no events and keeps the place.
task.wait(0.3)
s.Playing = false
local t = s.TimePosition
s.Playing = true
log("Playing set directly", near(s.TimePosition, t))

-- A seek past the end ends it; a negative one plays from the start.
s.TimePosition = 20
task.wait(0.2)
log("seek past end", s.Playing, s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
s.TimePosition = -1
log("negative reads", s.TimePosition)
task.wait(0.3)
log("negative plays from 0", near(s.TimePosition, 0.3))

-- The end: Ended, stopped and rewound; Play then starts where a script
-- last set the position.
s.TimePosition = 9.7
task.wait(0.6)
log("ended", s.Playing, s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
log("play after end", near(s.TimePosition, 9.7))
s:Stop()

-- Looped: DidLoop instead of Ended.
s.Looped = true
s.TimePosition = 9.8
s:Play()
task.wait(0.5)
log("looped", s.Playing, near(s.TimePosition, 0.3))
s.Looped = false
s:Stop()

-- PlaybackSpeed scales time; Volume and PlaybackSpeed are clamped.
s.PlaybackSpeed = 2
s.TimePosition = 1
s:Play()
task.wait(1)
-- Twice as far as the 1 s waited (wait overshoots, doubled here).
log("double speed", s.TimePosition > 2.8 and s.TimePosition < 3.3)
s:Stop()
for _, v in { -1, 25, math.huge } do
    s.PlaybackSpeed = v
    log("PlaybackSpeed", v, s.PlaybackSpeed, s.Pitch)
end
for _, v in { -1, 11 } do
    s.Volume = v
    log("Volume", v, s.Volume)
end
log("server PlaybackLoudness", s.PlaybackLoudness)
s:Destroy()

--!strict
-- Pic.lua -- 8259A master/slave pair.
--
-- The PC's two 8259s are initialized by the BIOS with ICW1-ICW4, remapped away
-- from the 8086 vectors, then driven by the PIT/RTC/keyboard. This model keeps
-- the architectural IRR/ISR/IMR state and the master/slave cascade (IRQ2), but
-- does not simulate interrupt-acknowledge bus timing: Machine takes a pending
-- vector, delivers it to the CPU, and the guest's EOI clears the ISR bit.

const band, bor, bnot, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot, bit32.lshift

const Pic = {}
Pic.__index = Pic

type Chip = {
	irr: number,
	isr: number,
	imr: number,
	vectorBase: number,
	initStep: number,
	icw4: boolean,
	single: boolean,
	readIsr: boolean,
	level: boolean,
	poll: boolean,
}

export type Pic = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		master: Chip,
		slave: Chip,
		pendingVector: number?,
		in8: (self: Pic, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Pic, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		raise: (self: Pic, irq: number) -> (),
		syncCascade: (self: Pic) -> (),
		acknowledge: (self: Pic) -> (number?, number?),
		eoi: (self: Pic, irq: number?) -> (),
		nextPending: (self: Pic) -> number?,
		reset: (self: Pic) -> (),
	},
	Pic
))

local function newChip(vectorBase: number): Chip
	return {
		irr = 0,
		isr = 0,
		imr = 0xFF,
		vectorBase = vectorBase,
		initStep = 0,
		icw4 = false,
		single = false,
		readIsr = false,
		level = false,
		poll = false,
	}
end

function Pic.new(): Pic
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pic) :: any
	self.master = newChip(0x08)
	self.slave = newChip(0x70)
	self.pendingVector = nil
	return self
end

function Pic.reset(self: Pic)
	self.master = newChip(0x08)
	self.slave = newChip(0x70)
	self.pendingVector = nil
end

local function highestIsr(chip: Chip): number?
	for bit = 0, 7 do
		if band(chip.isr, lshift(1, bit)) ~= 0 then
			return bit
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The 8259 fixed-priority resolver: an in-service IRQ blocks itself and all
-- lower-priority IRQs. Only a higher-priority request may preempt it. Ignoring
-- ISR here would redeliver the same level and nest handlers incorrectly.
local function bestIrq(chip: Chip): number?
	local eligible = band(chip.irr, bnot(chip.imr))
	const inService = highestIsr(chip)
	if inService ~= nil then
		eligible = band(eligible, lshift(1, inService) - 1)
	end
	if eligible == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	for bit = 0, 7 do
		if band(eligible, lshift(1, bit)) ~= 0 then
			return bit
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function setBit(mask: number, bit: number, on: boolean): number
	if on then
		return bor(mask, lshift(1, bit))
	end
	return band(mask, bnot(lshift(1, bit)))
end

function Pic.raise(self: Pic, irq: number)
	if irq < 0 or irq > 15 then
		return
	end
	if irq < 8 then
		self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, irq, true)
		return
	end
	const slaveIrq = irq - 8
	self.slave.irr = setBit(self.slave.irr, slaveIrq, true)
	self:syncCascade()
end

-- The master's IR2 input is wired to the slave's INT output, which is high
-- exactly while the slave holds an unmasked request. Derive it instead of
-- latching it at raise time: a request raised while the slave is masked must
-- surface when the guest unmasks the slave (the Win9x ATAPI drivers mask
-- IRQ14 around data phases and unmask afterwards).
function Pic.syncCascade(self: Pic)
	const request = band(self.slave.irr, bnot(self.slave.imr))
	self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, 2, request ~= 0)
end

function Pic.nextPending(self: Pic): number?
	const masterIrq = bestIrq(self.master)
	if masterIrq == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if masterIrq == 2 then
		const slaveIrq = bestIrq(self.slave)
		if slaveIrq ~= nil then
			return self.slave.vectorBase + slaveIrq
		end
	end
	return self.master.vectorBase + masterIrq
end

function Pic.acknowledge(self: Pic): (number?, number?)
	const masterIrq = bestIrq(self.master)
	if masterIrq == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if masterIrq == 2 then
		const slaveIrq = bestIrq(self.slave)
		if slaveIrq ~= nil then
			self.slave.irr = setBit(self.slave.irr, slaveIrq, false)
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveIrq, true)
			-- The slave's INT output may stay high when another request is
			-- already queued behind the one being acknowledged.
			self:syncCascade()
			self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, true)
			return self.slave.vectorBase + slaveIrq, 8 + slaveIrq
		end
	end
	self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, masterIrq, false)
	self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, masterIrq, true)
	return self.master.vectorBase + masterIrq, masterIrq
end

function Pic.eoi(self: Pic, irq: number?)
	if irq ~= nil then
		if irq >= 8 then
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, irq - 8, false)
			-- Only release the cascade line once the slave has no in-service
			-- interrupts left.
			if self.slave.isr == 0 then
				self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, false)
			end
			self:syncCascade()
		else
			self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, irq, false)
		end
		return
	end
	-- Non-specific EOI clears the highest-priority in-service bit.
	const masterBit = highestIsr(self.master)
	if masterBit == nil then
		return
	end
	self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, masterBit, false)
	if masterBit == 2 then
		const slaveBit = highestIsr(self.slave)
		if slaveBit ~= nil then
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveBit, false)
		end
	end
	self:syncCascade()
end

-- A non-specific EOI written to the slave command port clears the slave, not
-- the master. This is the normal end of an IRQ8-15 handler sequence.
local function eoiSlave(self: Pic)
	const slaveBit = highestIsr(self.slave)
	if slaveBit == nil then
		return
	end
	self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveBit, false)
	if self.slave.isr == 0 then
		self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, false)
	end
	self:syncCascade()
end

local function writeChip(self: Pic, chip: Chip, port: number, value: number)
	if port == 0 then
		if band(value, 0x10) ~= 0 then
			chip.initStep = 1
			chip.icw4 = band(value, 0x01) ~= 0
			chip.single = band(value, 0x02) ~= 0
			chip.level = band(value, 0x08) ~= 0
			chip.irr = 0
			chip.isr = 0
			self:syncCascade()
			return
		end
		if band(value, 0x08) ~= 0 then
			-- OCW3: RR (bit 1) selects the register the next command-port read
			-- returns and RIS (bit 0) picks ISR over IRR; a write with RR clear leaves
			-- the selection alone. P (bit 2) makes the next read a poll command.
			-- Win98's VPICD reads IRR with 0Ah and polls during init.
			if band(value, 0x02) ~= 0 then
				chip.readIsr = band(value, 0x01) ~= 0
			end
			chip.poll = band(value, 0x04) ~= 0
			return
		end
		-- OCW2: end-of-interrupt (specific when bit 6 is set).
		if band(value, 0x20) ~= 0 then
			if band(value, 0x40) ~= 0 then
				self:eoi(band(value, 7) + (if chip == self.slave then 8 else 0))
			elseif chip == self.slave then
				eoiSlave(self)
			else
				self:eoi(nil)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 1 then
		chip.vectorBase = band(value, 0xF8)
		chip.initStep = if chip.single then (if chip.icw4 then 4 else 0) else 2
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 2 then
		-- ICW3: master cascade mask / slave cascade identity. The single bit in
		-- IRQ2 is the only cascade route this machine exposes.
		chip.initStep = if chip.icw4 then 4 else 0
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 4 then
		chip.initStep = 0
		return
	end
	chip.imr = band(value, 0xFF)
	self:syncCascade()
end

function Pic.out8(self: Pic, port: number, value: number)
	if port == 0x20 or port == 0x21 then
		writeChip(self, self.master, port - 0x20, value)
	elseif port == 0xA0 or port == 0xA1 then
		writeChip(self, self.slave, port - 0xA0, value)
	end
end

function Pic.in8(self: Pic, port: number): number
	local chip, isCommand
	if port == 0x20 then
		chip, isCommand = self.master, true
	elseif port == 0x21 then
		chip, isCommand = self.master, false
	elseif port == 0xA0 then
		chip, isCommand = self.slave, true
	elseif port == 0xA1 then
		chip, isCommand = self.slave, false
	else
		return 0xFF
	end
	if not isCommand then
		return chip.imr
	end
	if chip.poll then
		-- Poll command: acknowledge the highest pending request like INTA would and
		-- return bit 7 plus its level; 0 when nothing is pending.
		chip.poll = false
		const irq = bestIrq(chip)
		if irq == nil then
			return 0
		end
		chip.irr = setBit(chip.irr, irq, false)
		chip.isr = setBit(chip.isr, irq, true)
		self:syncCascade()
		return bor(0x80, irq)
	end
	return if chip.readIsr then chip.isr else chip.irr
end

return Pic

local function show(class, props)
	local e = Instance.new(class)
	local values = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(props) do
		table.insert(values, p .. "=" .. string.format("%.2f", e[p]))
	end
	log(class, e.Enabled, e.Priority, table.concat(values, " "))
	e:Destroy()
end

show("ReverbSoundEffect", { "DecayTime", "Density", "Diffusion", "DryLevel", "WetLevel" })

--!strict
-- Keys themselves: setting, removing and shaping them, clearing a range, copying a pose.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Body = require("./Body")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local asymmetry = Body.asymmetry
local count = Frames.count
local counterpart = Body.counterpart
local hasGeometry = Body.hasGeometry
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local MIRROR_SIGN = Body.MIRROR_SIGN
local near = Frames.near
local needJoint = Need.needJoint
local needJoints = Need.needJoints
local needOneOf = Need.needOneOf
local needRange = Need.needRange
local needTime = Need.needTime
local needVector = Need.needVector
local outward = Store.outward
local putKey = Write.putKey
local readChannels = Frames.readChannels
local refuse = Need.refuse
local smoothChannel = Write.smoothChannel

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context
type Key = Store.Key

local Ops = {}

Ops.set_key = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needJoint(where, operation.joint, joints)
		needTime(where, operation.time, "time")
		needVector(where, operation.rotation, "rotation")
		needVector(where, operation.position, "position", Store.MAX_POSITION)
		if operation.rotation == nil and operation.position == nil then
			refuse(where, "give rotation, position or both.")
		end
		if operation.interpolation ~= nil then
			needOneOf(where, operation.interpolation, "interpolation", Store.INTERPOLATIONS)
		end
	end,

	apply = function(_where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local mode = operation.interpolation
		for axis, letter in { "x", "y", "z" } do
			if operation.rotation then
				local curve = Store.channel(clip, operation.joint, `rotation.{letter}`, true) :: Instance
				putKey(curve, operation.time, math.rad(operation.rotation[axis]), mode, changed)
			end
			if operation.position then
				local curve = Store.channel(clip, operation.joint, `position.{letter}`, true) :: Instance
				putKey(curve, operation.time, operation.position[axis], mode, changed)
			end
		end
	end,
}

Ops.remove_key = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needJoint(where, operation.joint, joints)
		needTime(where, operation.time, "time")
		if operation.channels ~= nil then
			if type(operation.channels) ~= "table" or #operation.channels == 0 then
				refuse(where, "channels must list at least one of rotation, position.")
			end
			for _, name in operation.channels do
				needOneOf(where, name, "each of channels", { "rotation", "position" })
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local kinds = operation.channels or { "rotation", "position" }
		local removed = 0
		for _, kind in kinds do
			for _, letter in { "x", "y", "z" } do
				local curve = Store.channel(clip, operation.joint, `{kind}.{letter}`, false)
				if curve then
					local keys = Store.keys(curve)
					local kept = {}
					for _, key in keys do
						if near(key.time, operation.time) then
							removed += 1
						else
							table.insert(kept, key)
						end
					end
					if #kept ~= #keys then
						Store.setKeys(curve, kept)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if removed == 0 then
			refuse(where, `"{operation.joint}" has no key at {operation.time} seconds.`)
		end
		count(changed, "keys_removed", removed)
	end,
}

Ops.set_tangent = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needJoint(where, operation.joint, joints)
		needTime(where, operation.time, "time")
		needOneOf(where, operation.channel, "channel", Store.CHANNELS)
		if operation["in"] == nil and operation.out == nil then
			refuse(where, "give in, out or both.")
		end
		for _, field in { "in", "out" } do
			if operation[field] ~= nil and not isFinite(operation[field]) then
				refuse(where, `{field} must be a finite number.`)
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local curve = Store.channel(clip, operation.joint, operation.channel, false)
		local keys: { Key } = if curve then Store.keys(curve) else {}
		local scale = outward(operation.channel)
		for index, key in keys do
			if near(key.time, operation.time) then
				if operation["in"] ~= nil then
					key.left = operation["in"] / scale
				end
				if operation.out ~= nil then
					if index == #keys then
						refuse(where, "the last key of a curve has no stretch after it, so no outgoing tangent.")
					end
					key.interpolation = "Cubic"
					key.right = operation.out / scale
				end
				Store.setKeys(curve :: Instance, keys)
				count(changed, "tangents_set")
				return
			end
		end
		refuse(where, `"{operation.joint}" has no {operation.channel} key at {operation.time} seconds.`)
	end,
}

Ops.auto_tangents = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needRange(where, operation)
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		if operation.snap_at ~= nil then
			if type(operation.snap_at) ~= "table" or #operation.snap_at > Store.MAX_SNAPS then
				refuse(where, `snap_at must list at most {Store.MAX_SNAPS} times.`)
			end
			for _, time in operation.snap_at do
				needTime(where, time, "each time in snap_at")
			end
		end
		if operation.loop ~= nil and type(operation.loop) ~= "boolean" then
			refuse(where, "loop must be true or false.")
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local wanted: { [string]: boolean }? = nil
		if operation.joints then
			wanted = {}
			for _, name in operation.joints do
				(wanted :: { [string]: boolean })[name] = true
			end
		end
		local duration = Store.duration(clip)
		local whole = near(operation.time_from, 0) and near(operation.time_to, duration)
		local loop = if operation.loop ~= nil then operation.loop else ((clip :: any).Loop == true and whole)
		local written = 0
		for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
			if not wanted or wanted[track.joint] then
				written += smoothChannel(
					track.curve,
					operation.time_from,
					operation.time_to,
					operation.snap_at or {},
					loop
				)
			end
		end
		if written == 0 then
			refuse(
				where,
				`no channel has two or more keys with one from {operation.time_from} to {operation.time_to} seconds.`
			)
		end
		count(changed, "keys_changed", written)
	end,
}

Ops.clear_keys = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needRange(where, operation)
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		if operation.channels ~= nil then
			if type(operation.channels) ~= "table" or #operation.channels == 0 then
				refuse(where, "channels must list at least one of rotation, position.")
			end
			for _, name in operation.channels do
				needOneOf(where, name, "each of channels", { "rotation", "position" })
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(_where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local wanted: { [string]: boolean }? = nil
		if operation.joints then
			wanted = {}
			for _, name in operation.joints do
				(wanted :: { [string]: boolean })[name] = true
			end
		end
		local kinds = {}
		for _, kind in operation.channels or { "rotation", "position" } do
			kinds[kind] = true
		end
		local from, to = operation.time_from, operation.time_to
		local removed = 0
		for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
			local kind = string.match(track.channel, "^(%a+)%.")
			if (wanted and not wanted[track.joint]) or not kinds[kind] then
				continue
			end
			local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
			local kept = {}
			for _, key in keys do
				if key.time >= from - Store.TIME_TOLERANCE and key.time <= to + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
					removed += 1
				else
					table.insert(kept, key)
				end
			end
			if #kept ~= #keys then
				Store.setKeys(track.curve, kept)
			end
		end
		count(changed, "keys_removed", removed)
	end,
}

Ops.copy_pose = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needTime(where, operation.from, "from")
		needTime(where, operation.to, "to")
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		if
			operation.from_clip ~= nil
			and (type(operation.from_clip) ~= "string" or #operation.from_clip == 0 or #operation.from_clip > 120)
		then
			refuse(where, "from_clip must name a clip.")
		end
		if operation.mirror ~= nil and type(operation.mirror) ~= "boolean" then
			refuse(where, "mirror must be true or false.")
		end
		if operation.channels ~= nil then
			if type(operation.channels) ~= "table" or #operation.channels == 0 then
				refuse(where, "channels must list at least one of rotation, position.")
			end
			for _, name in operation.channels do
				needOneOf(where, name, "each of channels", { "rotation", "position" })
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local joints = context.joints
		local mirrored = operation.mirror == true
		if mirrored then
			if not hasGeometry(joints, Rig.R15_ORDER) then
				refuse(where, "this rig's joints could not be measured, so a pose cannot be mirrored on it.")
			end
			local problem = asymmetry(joints)
			if problem then
				refuse(
					where,
					`this rig's sides are not mirror images, so a mirrored pose would not be exact: {problem}`
				)
			end
		end
		local kinds = {}
		for _, kind in operation.channels or { "rotation", "position" } do
			kinds[kind] = true
		end
		local names: { string } = operation.joints or Rig.R15_ORDER
		-- The pose comes from this clip, or from another of the same rig: the guard of a
		-- ready pose carried into an attack, say. The other clip is only read.
		local origin = clip
		if operation.from_clip ~= nil then
			local found = context.clips and context.clips[operation.from_clip]
			if not found then
				refuse(where, `the clip "{operation.from_clip}" to copy the pose from was not found.`)
			end
			origin = found :: Instance
			-- A keyframe clip comes as its pose sampled at `from`, its length checked already.
			local length = Store.duration(origin)
			if origin:GetAttribute(Store.SAMPLED) ~= true and operation.from > length + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
				refuse(where, `the clip to copy from ends at {Need.milliseconds(length)} seconds, before from.`)
			end
		end
		-- Everything is read before anything is written, so a mirrored pose copied onto
		-- the time it came from swaps the sides instead of copying one onto itself.
		local channels = readChannels(origin)
		-- Which channels this clip animates: a channel it animates that the other clip
		-- leaves at rest is keyed to rest, so no part of the old pose is left behind.
		local own = if origin == clip then channels else readChannels(clip)
		local plan: { { joint: string, channel: string, value: number } } = {}
		for _, joint in names do
			local source = if mirrored then counterpart(joint) else joint
			for _, channel in Store.CHANNELS do
				if not kinds[string.match(channel, "^(%a+)%.") :: string] then
					continue
				end
				local from = channels[source] and channels[source][channel]
				local to = own[joint] and own[joint][channel]
				if (from == nil or #from == 0) and (to == nil or #to == 0) then
					-- Neither moves on this channel: it is at rest at both times already.
					continue
				end
				local value = if from then Store.evaluate(from, operation.from) else 0
				if mirrored then
					value *= MIRROR_SIGN[channel]
				end
				table.insert(plan, { joint = joint, channel = channel, value = value })
			end
		end
		if #plan == 0 then
			refuse(where, "none of these joints is keyed, so there is no pose to copy.")
		end
		for _, entry in plan do
			putKey(
				Store.channel(clip, entry.joint, entry.channel, true) :: Instance,
				operation.to,
				entry.value,
				nil,
				changed
			)
		end
		count(changed, "poses_copied")
	end,
}

return Ops

--!strict
-- Pit.lua -- 8254 programmable interval timer.
--
-- Machine advances all three counters once per emulated instruction. Channel 0
-- raises IRQ0 every reload; channel 1 is the refresh timer and channel 2 drives
-- the PC speaker. The BIOS uses channel 0 both for the system tick and as a
-- calibrated delay source, so reads must return a changing count.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Pit = {}
Pit.__index = Pit

const CHANNELS = 3

type Channel = {
	reload: number,
	counter: number,
	access: number, -- 1 LSB, 2 MSB, 3 LSB-then-MSB
	mode: number,
	bcd: boolean,
	flipFlop: number,
	latched: number?,
	statusLatched: number?, -- read-back status byte, returned before the count
	output: boolean,
}

export type Pit = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		channels: { Channel },
		irqPending: boolean,
		channel0Divisor: number,
		channel0Phase: number,
		in8: (self: Pit, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Pit, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		advance: (self: Pit, cycles: number) -> boolean,
		reset: (self: Pit) -> (),
	},
	Pit
))

local function newChannel(): Channel
	return {
		reload = 0,
		counter = 0x10000,
		access = 3,
		mode = 3,
		bcd = false,
		flipFlop = 0,
		latched = nil,
		statusLatched = nil,
		output = false,
	}
end

function Pit.new(): Pit
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pit) :: any
	self.channels = { newChannel(), newChannel(), newChannel() }
	self.irqPending = false
	-- Channel 0 (IRQ0) advances once per `channel0Divisor` advance() calls so a
	-- host can keep channel 2 fast (speed benchmarks) without flooding guests
	-- with timer IRQs far above real-time rate.
	self.channel0Divisor = 1
	self.channel0Phase = 0
	return self
end

function Pit.reset(self: Pit)
	self.channels = { newChannel(), newChannel(), newChannel() }
	self.irqPending = false
end

local function reloadValue(channel: Channel): number
	return if channel.reload == 0 then 0x10000 else channel.reload
end

function Pit.advance(self: Pit, cycles: number): boolean
	local irq = false
	const channels = self.channels
	-- Channel 0 sees one count per `channel0Divisor` guest steps; batched calls
	-- (cycles > 1) carry the remainder in channel0Phase.
	local channel0Cycles = cycles
	if self.channel0Divisor > 1 then
		const total = self.channel0Phase + cycles
		channel0Cycles = total // self.channel0Divisor
		self.channel0Phase = total - channel0Cycles * self.channel0Divisor
	end
	for index = 0, CHANNELS - 1 do
		const ticks = if index == 0 then channel0Cycles else cycles
		if ticks == 0 then
			continue
		end
		const channel = channels[index + 1]
		-- Inline reloadValue: advance runs once per guest instruction.
		const period = if channel.reload == 0 then 0x10000 else channel.reload
		local remaining = channel.counter - ticks
		while remaining <= 0 do
			remaining += period
			if index == 0 then
				irq = true
			end
			-- Mode 0 (interrupt on terminal count) drives the output high at
			-- the terminal count and leaves it high until reprogrammed. SeaBIOS
			-- uses this on channel 2 for TSC calibration and polls PPI bit 5.
			if channel.mode == 0 then
				channel.output = true
			else
				channel.output = not channel.output
			end
		end
		channel.counter = remaining
	end
	if irq then
		self.irqPending = true
	end
	return irq
end

-- Guest steps until channel 0 next reaches terminal count (its IRQ0 edge), so
-- a halted CPU can skip straight to it.
function Pit.stepsToIrq0(self: Pit): number
	const channel = self.channels[1]
	const counts = math.max(1, channel.counter)
	if self.channel0Divisor > 1 then
		return math.max(1, counts * self.channel0Divisor - self.channel0Phase)
	end
	return counts
end

function Pit.out8(self: Pit, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if port == 0x43 then
		const channelIndex = rshift(value, 6)
		if channelIndex == 3 then
			-- Read-back command (11 !COUNT !STATUS C2 C1 C0 0). Bits 1-3 select
			-- channels; a clear bit 5 latches the count, a clear bit 4 latches
			-- the status byte, which the next read returns before the count.
			-- WIN98 SETUP times IDIV with 0xC8 (channel 2, count + status).
			const latchCount = band(value, 0x20) == 0
			const latchStatus = band(value, 0x10) == 0
			for index = 0, 2 do
				if band(value, lshift(2, index)) ~= 0 then
					const target = self.channels[index + 1]
					if latchCount and target.latched == nil then
						target.latched = target.counter
					end
					if latchStatus and target.statusLatched == nil then
						target.statusLatched = bor(
							if target.output then 0x80 else 0,
							lshift(target.access, 4),
							lshift(target.mode, 1),
							if target.bcd then 1 else 0
						)
					end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		const channel = self.channels[channelIndex + 1]
		channel.access = band(rshift(value, 4), 3)
		channel.mode = band(rshift(value, 1), 7)
		channel.bcd = band(value, 1) ~= 0
		channel.flipFlop = 0
		if channel.access == 0 then
			channel.latched = channel.counter
		end
		return
	end
	if port >= 0x40 and port <= 0x42 then
		const channel = self.channels[port - 0x40 + 1]
		if channel.access == 1 then
			channel.reload = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif channel.access == 2 then
			channel.reload = lshift(band(value, 0xFF), 8)
		else
			if channel.flipFlop == 0 then
				channel.reload = band(channel.reload, 0xFF00) + band(value, 0xFF)
				channel.flipFlop = 1
			else
				channel.reload = band(value, 0xFF) * 0x100 + band(channel.reload, 0xFF)
				channel.flipFlop = 0
			end
		end
		channel.counter = reloadValue(channel)
		channel.output = false
	end
end

function Pit.in8(self: Pit, port: number): number
	if port < 0x40 or port > 0x42 then
		return 0xFF
	end
	const channel = self.channels[port - 0x40 + 1]
	if channel.statusLatched ~= nil then
		const status = channel.statusLatched :: number
		channel.statusLatched = nil
		return status
	end
	local value
	if channel.latched ~= nil then
		value = channel.latched :: number
	else
		value = channel.counter
	end
	local result
	if channel.access == 1 then
		result = band(value, 0xFF)
	elseif channel.access == 2 then
		result = band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF)
	else
		if channel.flipFlop == 0 then
			result = band(value, 0xFF)
			channel.flipFlop = 1
		else
			result = band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF)
			channel.flipFlop = 0
			channel.latched = nil
		end
	end
	return result
end

return Pit

--!strict
-- Adding a turn, a move or a sway on top of a clip's motion.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local addToChannel = Write.addToChannel
local count = Frames.count
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local near = Frames.near
local needBlends = Need.needBlends
local needJoint = Need.needJoint
local needJoints = Need.needJoints
local needRange = Need.needRange
local needVector = Need.needVector
local refuse = Need.refuse
local spanOf = Frames.spanOf

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context

local Ops = {}

-- A smooth sway of size about 1, the same for the same seed: three waves, each twice as
-- fast as the one before and half as large, at chance phases. With `period`, every wave
-- fits a whole number of times into it, so the sway comes back round to where it began.
local function sway(seed: number, frequency: number, period: number?): (time: number) -> number
	local state = seed % 2147483647
	if state <= 0 then
		state += 2147483646
	end
	local function chance(): number
		state = (state * 48271) % 2147483647
		return state / 2147483647
	end
	local waves = {}
	for octave = 0, 2 do
		local speed = frequency * 2 ^ octave * (0.85 + 0.3 * chance())
		if period then
			speed = math.max(1, math.round(speed * period)) / period
		end
		table.insert(waves, { speed = speed, phase = chance() * 2 * math.pi, size = 0.5 ^ octave })
	end
	return function(time: number): number
		local total = 0
		for _, wave in waves do
			total += wave.size * math.sin(2 * math.pi * wave.speed * time + wave.phase)
		end
		return total / 1.75
	end
end

-- A number from a joint's and a channel's names, so each gets its own sway from one seed.
local function nameSeed(text: string): number
	local hash = 5381
	for index = 1, #text do
		hash = (hash * 33 + string.byte(text, index)) % 2147483647
	end
	return hash
end

Ops.add_offset = {
	-- Its range may run across a looping clip's end (see Seam).
	wraps = true,

	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needJoint(where, operation.joint, joints)
		needRange(where, operation, true)
		needVector(where, operation.rotation, "rotation")
		needVector(where, operation.position, "position", Store.MAX_POSITION)
		if operation.rotation == nil and operation.position == nil then
			refuse(where, "give rotation, position or both.")
		end
		needBlends(where, operation)
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local span = spanOf(where, clip, operation)
		for axis, letter in { "x", "y", "z" } do
			if operation.rotation and operation.rotation[axis] ~= 0 then
				local size = math.rad(operation.rotation[axis])
				addToChannel(clip, operation.joint, `rotation.{letter}`, span, function(time)
					return size * span.weight(time)
				end, changed)
			end
			if operation.position and operation.position[axis] ~= 0 then
				local size = operation.position[axis]
				addToChannel(clip, operation.joint, `position.{letter}`, span, function(time)
					return size * span.weight(time)
				end, changed)
			end
		end
		count(changed, "frames_offset", span.last - span.first + 1)
	end,
}

Ops.add_noise = {
	-- Its range may run across a looping clip's end (see Seam).
	wraps = true,

	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needRange(where, operation, true)
		if type(operation.joints) ~= "table" or #operation.joints == 0 then
			refuse(where, "joints must name at least one joint.")
		end
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		local degrees, studs = operation.rotation_degrees or 0, operation.position_studs or 0
		if not isFinite(degrees) or degrees < 0 or degrees > Store.MAX_NOISE_DEGREES then
			refuse(where, `rotation_degrees must be from 0 to {Store.MAX_NOISE_DEGREES}.`)
		end
		if not isFinite(studs) or studs < 0 or studs > Store.MAX_NOISE_STUDS then
			refuse(where, `position_studs must be from 0 to {Store.MAX_NOISE_STUDS}.`)
		end
		if degrees == 0 and studs == 0 then
			refuse(where, "give rotation_degrees, position_studs or both.")
		end
		local frequency = operation.frequency or 1
		if not isFinite(frequency) or frequency < Store.MIN_FREQUENCY or frequency > Store.MAX_FREQUENCY then
			refuse(where, `frequency must be from {Store.MIN_FREQUENCY} to {Store.MAX_FREQUENCY} waves a second.`)
		end
		if operation.seed ~= nil and (not isFinite(operation.seed) or operation.seed ~= math.floor(operation.seed)) then
			refuse(where, "seed must be a whole number.")
		end
		needBlends(where, operation)
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local span = spanOf(where, clip, operation)
		local duration = Store.duration(clip)
		-- Over a whole looping clip, the sway comes back round to where it began.
		local whole = near(operation.time_from, 0) and near(operation.time_to, duration)
		local period = if (clip :: any).Loop == true and whole then duration else nil
		local seed = operation.seed or 1
		local frequency = operation.frequency or 1
		local degrees = math.rad(operation.rotation_degrees or 0)
		local studs = operation.position_studs or 0
		for _, joint in operation.joints do
			for _, channel in Store.CHANNELS do
				local size = if string.sub(channel, 1, 8) == "rotation" then degrees else studs
				if size > 0 then
					local wave = sway(seed * 7919 + nameSeed(joint .. channel), frequency, period)
					addToChannel(clip, joint, channel, span, function(time)
						return size * wave(time) * span.weight(time)
					end, changed)
				end
			end
		end
		count(changed, "frames_with_noise", span.last - span.first + 1)
	end,
}

return Ops

--!strict
-- Mirroring motion across the rig's middle, or copying one side onto the other.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Body = require("./Body")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local asymmetry = Body.asymmetry
local count = Frames.count
local counterpart = Body.counterpart
local hasGeometry = Body.hasGeometry
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local MIRROR_SIGN = Body.MIRROR_SIGN
local needJoints = Need.needJoints
local needOneOf = Need.needOneOf
local readChannels = Frames.readChannels
local refuse = Need.refuse
local wrapped = Write.wrapped

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context
type Key = Store.Key

local Ops = {}

Ops.mirror = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needOneOf(where, operation.mode, "mode", Store.MIRROR_MODES)
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		if operation.offset ~= nil then
			if not isFinite(operation.offset) or math.abs(operation.offset) > Store.MAX_TIME then
				refuse(where, "offset must be a number of seconds.")
			end
			if operation.mode == "flip" and operation.offset ~= 0 then
				refuse(where, "offset is for copying one side onto the other, not for flip.")
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local joints = context.joints
		if not hasGeometry(joints, Rig.R15_ORDER) then
			refuse(where, "this rig's joints could not be measured, so it cannot be mirrored.")
		end
		local problem = asymmetry(joints)
		if problem then
			refuse(where, `this rig's sides are not mirror images, so a mirror would not be exact: {problem}`)
		end
		local offset = operation.offset or 0
		local duration = Store.duration(clip)
		if offset ~= 0 and not (clip :: any).Loop then
			refuse(where, "an offset carries motion round from the end to the start, so it needs a looping clip.")
		end
		local mode = operation.mode
		local only: { [string]: boolean }? = nil
		if operation.joints then
			only = {}
			for _, name in operation.joints do
				(only :: { [string]: boolean })[name] = true
				(only :: { [string]: boolean })[counterpart(name)] = true
			end
		end
		-- Which joint each joint's new curves come from.
		local plan: { { to: string, from: string } } = {}
		for _, name in Rig.R15_ORDER do
			if only and not only[name] then
				continue
			end
			local other = counterpart(name)
			local side = string.sub(name, 1, 4) == "Left"
			if mode == "flip" then
				table.insert(plan, { to = name, from = other })
			elseif mode == "left_to_right" and side then
				table.insert(plan, { to = other, from = name })
			elseif mode == "right_to_left" and other ~= name and not side then
				table.insert(plan, { to = other, from = name })
			end
		end
		-- Everything is read before anything is written: in a flip, each side is read
		-- before it is replaced by the other.
		local channels = readChannels(clip)
		local written = {}
		for _, pair in plan do
			local own = channels[pair.from] or {}
			for _, channel in Store.CHANNELS do
				local source = own[channel]
				local target = Store.channel(clip, pair.to, channel, false)
				if not source or #source == 0 then
					-- The joint copied from does not move here, so neither does its mirror.
					if target and #Store.keys(target) > 0 then
						table.insert(written, { joint = pair.to, channel = channel, keys = {} })
					end
					continue
				end
				local sign = MIRROR_SIGN[channel]
				local keys: { Key } = {}
				for _, key in source do
					table.insert(keys, {
						time = key.time,
						value = key.value * sign,
						interpolation = key.interpolation,
						left = if key.left then key.left * sign else nil,
						right = if key.right then key.right * sign else nil,
					})
				end
				if offset ~= 0 then
					keys = wrapped(keys, offset, duration)
				end
				table.insert(written, { joint = pair.to, channel = channel, keys = keys })
			end
		end
		local total = 0
		for _, entry in written do
			Store.setKeys(Store.channel(clip, entry.joint, entry.channel, true) :: Instance, entry.keys)
			total += #entry.keys
		end
		count(changed, "keys_written", total)
		count(changed, "joints_mirrored", #plan)
	end,
}

return Ops
